raw.description:
IT Senior Cloud Architect

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Cloud Architect to lead the design, implementation, and governance of our cloud infrastructure. In this role, you will define the technical direction for our cloud environment, ensure it is secure, scalable, and cost-efficient, and act as the go-to expert for architectural decisions across the organization. As we develop software and provide SaaS and PaaS solutions to our customers, you will work closely with engineering, security and operations teams as well as our Software R&D and Software development teams to translate business requirements into robust cloud solutions, while establishing best practices and standards that guide our long-term cloud strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and own the overall cloud architecture, including infrastructure topology, account/subscription structure, networking and governance models.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into scalable, resilient and secure cloud architectures.
  • Define and enforce security best practices, including identity and access management, network segmentation, encryption and data protection, in line with relevant regulatory and compliance frameworks.
  • Establish cost governance practices together with the FinOps Manager to monitor, forecast and optimize cloud spend.
  • Drive adoption of Infrastructure as Code and automation practices to improve deployment speed, consistency and reliability.
  • Partner with engineering, operations, software developer and security teams to align infrastructure decisions with product and business goals.
  • Support the Software R&D and Software development team to build robust and scalable SaaS and PaaS solutions.
  • Define architecture standards, conduct design reviews and ensure consistency across teams and projects.
  • Guide and mentor engineers on cloud architecture principles and best practices.
  • Continuously evaluate new cloud services, tools and industry trends to improve the organization's technical capabilities.
  • Contribute to disaster recovery planning, high-availability design and incident response processes.

Required Experience and Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure engineering or a related senior technical role.

  • Proven track record designing and implementing large-scale, enterprise-grade cloud solutions.

  • Primary experience with Microsoft Azure cloud platforms; AWS experience is beneficial

  • Strong understanding of cloud security principles: IAM, encryption, network security, and zero-trust architecture.

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to your industry (e.g., GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2).

  • Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g. Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep/ARM).

  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Scripting/programming skills (e.g., Python, Go or similar) and familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts (VPNs, VPCs/VNets, load balancing, DNS).

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Experience mentoring and guiding engineering teams.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Fluent in English (business level)

We Offer

Freedom with responsibility is the framework for HBK’s employees. This allows for a good balance between work and family life and for constant development of professional and personal skills in an international and enjoyable working environment.

One company – HBK

On 1 January 2019, Brüel & Kjær and HBM merged their activities into a new company called HBK (Hottinger Brüel & Kjær). With more than 3,500 employees worldwide and production facilities in Denmark, Germany, Austria, UK, USA, China and Portugal and presence in 80 countries, HBK is a leading player in the test and measurement area. Finance and Administration Manager (Caribbean – Remote)

Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Finance and Administration Manager to lead the company's financial operations and administrative functions across Latin America. This role is responsible for overseeing accounting, financial reporting, budgeting, compliance, and internal controls, while also managing administrative processes that support business operations. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong leadership capability, strategic financial insight, and hands-on execution experience in a remote, multi-country environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee end-to-end accounting operations, including general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, payroll coordination, and month-end/year-end close.
  • Ensure compliance with local financial, tax, and statutory regulations across assigned Latin American jurisdictions.
  • Prepare, review, and present accurate financial statements, management reports, and variance analyses to senior leadership.
  • Lead budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow management processes to support business planning and decision-making.
  • Establish, implement, and maintain internal controls, financial policies, and procedures to ensure governance and risk mitigation.
  • Manage and optimize the use of accounting systems, ERP tools, and financial reporting platforms.
  • Coordinate with external auditors, tax consultants, banks, and regulatory authorities as required.
  • Oversee administrative operations, including vendor management, contracts, documentation, and operational support functions.
  • Provide guidance, mentoring, and performance oversight to accounting and administrative team members.
  • Support senior management with ad hoc financial analysis and strategic initiatives.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field (Masters degree or professional certification is a plus).
  • Minimum of 5+ years of progressive experience in finance and accounting, with at least 2 years in a managerial or supervisory role.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting standards, financial controls, budgeting, and regulatory compliance.
  • Experience working with Latin American financial regulations and multi-entity environments is highly preferred.
  • Proficiency in accounting software and ERP systems (e.g., QuickBooks, Sage, NetSuite, or similar).
  • Advanced Excel skills and strong capability in financial modeling and analysis.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work independently in a remote setup.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • High level of integrity, accuracy, and attention to detail.

At Deckers Brands, Together, Every Step is a promise kept that every employee can bring their authentic self, is valued and supported, as a whole person, at work and beyond. Job Title:Sr. Merchandiser - US Teva Wholesale

Reports to:Sr. Manager, Merchandising - Teva Marketplace

Location: Remote - US

Interested applicants must reside in one of the following approved states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Indiana, Massachusetts, Minnesota, New York, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Washington

The Role

As the Sr. Merchandiser for US Wholesale, you will lead the execution of Teva’s seasonal directives and key initiatives for the US Wholesale channel. You’ll partner closely with Marketplace Planning and cross-functional teams to deliver the right product at the right place and time, supporting Teva’s financial goals and brand expression. Your leadership will drive disciplined, efficient, and sustainable assortment planning and buy execution for the America’s business.

We celebrate diversity--of your background, your experiences and your unique identity. We are committed to ensuring an inclusive and equitable workplace where all of our employees can Come as They Are. We believe that when we bring our different perspectives to work, we are truly Better Together.

Your Impact

  • Lead sales, receipt, margin, and style-color count targets seasonally, focusing on US Wholesale and aligning with brand strategies and trends
  • Develop and execute US Wholesale assortments that meet consumer requirements and financial targets
  • Collaborate with Regional Merchandising on future needs to ensure innovative product and flawless execution across the marketplace
  • Build strong partnerships with DTC, Distributors, Product, Marketing, Ecomm, Operations, Supply Planning, Merchandise Planning, Consumer Data & Analytics, and DTC partners
  • Present merchandise strategy and goals each season, informing inventory targets and top-down objectives
  • Deliver presentations during key GTM milestone meetings, QBRs, and MBRs to inform in-season and future opportunities
  • Partner with Merchandise Planning and Marketing to ensure forecasts reflect product initiatives, brand strategy, and demand plans
  • Identify in-season opportunities by analyzing retail metrics and outline profitable growth plans across categories
  • Champion Teva values and culture, fostering a diverse and inclusive workforce and environment
  • Instill high standards for collaboration and teamwork, identifying synergies and establishing common goals
  • Willing and able to travel 15-20% annually

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Minimum 7 years of experience in footwear and/or apparel merchandising, preferably within wholesale merchandising and planning
  • Strong analytical skills with advanced proficiency in Excel, retail math, and data-driven decision making
  • Proven ability to influence and drive results through collaboration, accountability, and effective stakeholder management
  • Demonstrated leadership in building compelling product assortments and driving brand and business results
  • Experience leading and influencing cross-functional partners in a matrixed environment, including Merchandising, Planning, Marketing, Ecommerce, and Product teams
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to identify opportunities, assess marketplace trends, and develop actionable strategies
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, negotiation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to tailor messages to diverse audiences

What We'll Give You –

  • Competitive Pay and Bonuses - We’ve created a variety of competitive compensation programs to foster career development, reward success and to show our employees just how much they’re valued.
  • Financial Planning and wellbeing - No matter what financial goals our employees have set, we want to help them get there. Our plans provide powerful ways to protect income, pay for expenses and invest in the future.
  • Time away from work - Sometimes we need time away to be with family, focus on our health or just simply recharge. Our plans support our employees’ needs to get out, get healthy and come back stronger than ever.
  • Extras, discounts and perks - Being a valued member of the Deckers Brands team means more than just a paycheck. From generous discounts to community-based programs, we offer a variety of cool extras
  • Growth and Development - Deckers Brands was built on the idea of pursuing passion. That’s why we offer extensive opportunities and support for personal and professional development.
  • Health and Wellness - There’s nothing basic about our comprehensive health and wellness programs and offerings. While at work and at play, we aim to support a healthy lifestyle.

raw.description:
The Opportunity:

Join Fandango's Platform Operations team as a Software Engineer II, where you'll help build and enhance the tools and systems that improve developer productivity across Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, and Fandango at Home.

Reporting to the Sr. Director, Platform Operations, you'll collaborate with experienced engineers to develop platform capabilities, improve internal tooling, and contribute to scalable engineering solutions. This role offers an opportunity to learn, grow, and make meaningful contributions while working on products that support engineering teams across the organization.

Why This Role Matters:

Developer productivity is critical to delivering great experiences for millions of customers. In this role, you'll help build and maintain the platforms and tools that enable engineering teams to develop, deploy, and operate software more efficiently while growing your technical expertise alongside a collaborative team.

Work Environment:

This is a fully remote position. While the role is remote, team members are expected to participate in periodic in-person collaboration opportunities (approximately 10% travel) to support team connection, planning, and business needs.

What You'll Do:

  • Contribute to the design, development, testing, and maintenance of internal platform tools and services under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Build and enhance backend services, APIs, and data models that support platform capabilities across multiple products.
  • Develop user-friendly frontend experiences for internal tools using React and Next.js.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established engineering standards and best practices.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, Platform, Infrastructure, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams to deliver reliable technical solutions.
  • Assist with monitoring, debugging, and troubleshooting applications using logging, metrics, and observability tools.
  • Support software deployments through CI/CD pipelines and participate in maintaining healthy production environments.
  • Contribute to technical documentation, code reviews, and continuous improvements to engineering processes and development workflows.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation with guidance from senior team members as experien

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent education or practical experience.
  • Demonstrated programming experience through internships, co-ops, academic projects, open-source contributions, or up to 2 years of professional software development experience.
  • Familiarity with one or more programming languages such as JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Exposure to modern web development frameworks such as React through coursework, projects, or professional experience.
  • Basic understanding of REST APIs, databases, and software development fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
  • Understanding of software testing concepts and a willingness to write maintainable, well-tested code.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity, and a desire to continuously learn and grow as a software engineer.
  • Effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate in a team-oriented environment

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Internship or project experience building web applications or internal tools.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS through coursework or personal projects.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and modern software development workflows.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar technologies.
  • Interest in developer productivity, platform engineering, or improving engineering workflows.

How We Do It:

Success in this role means demonstrating the behaviors that define how we work at Versant:

  • Trust: Deliver quality work, take ownership of your assignments, and ask for help when needed.
  • Teamwork: Collaborate respectfully with teammates, contribute to shared goals, and learn from others.
  • Transparency: Communicate openly about progress, challenges, and opportunities to improve.
  • Agility: Be adaptable, embrace feedback, and continuously develop your technical and professional skills.
  • Entrepreneurial Spirit: Show curiosity, take initiative to learn new technologies, and look for ways to improve the developer experience.

Why You’ll Love It Here:

  • Work on high-impact platforms at the intersection of sports, media, and technology
  • Opportunity to shape data strategy and influence decision-making at scale
  • Remote-first flexibility with meaningful opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection
  • Competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and growth opportunities across Versant’s portfolio

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with a VERSANT Media employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. VERSANT Media's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

For LA County and City Residents Only: VERSANT Media will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories, or arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with relevant legal requirements, including the City of Los Angeles' Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, where applicable.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and require support throughout the application and/or recruitment process as a result of your disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation. You can submit your request to .

VERSANT Media is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. We include a good faith pay range for each position to comply with applicable state and local pay transparency laws and to promote equity across our organization. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, experience, and location and may include additional forms of compensation and benefits such as health insurance, retirement plans, paid time off, etc.

VERSANT Media is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at VERSANT via-email, the Internet, or in any form and/or method without a valid written Statement of Work in place for this position from VERSANT's Talent Acquisition team will be deemed the sole property of VERSANT. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by VERSANT as a result of the referral or through other means.

VERSANT (Nasdaq: VSNT) is an industry-changing media and entertainment business and home to trusted brands that shape culture, inform audiences, and build lasting connections. It operates across four core markets: political news and opinion, business news and personal finance, golf, and sports and genre entertainment. These markets are served through a powerful portfolio of iconic and innovative brands, including CNBC, MS NOW, USA Network, Golf Channel, Oxygen, E!, SYFY, and Versant's sports division USA Sports, along with complementary digital assets including Fandango, Rotten Tomatoes, GolfNow and GolfPass.

raw.description:
The Credentialing Specialist is responsible for guiding travel healthcare candidates through the credentialing and compliance process, ensuring they meet facility and Aya requirements by established document due dates. This role serves as a key liaison between candidates, internal teams, and healthcare facilities while delivering a timely, accurate, and supportive experience in a fast-paced environment.

The duration of this temp role is expected to be about 4 months.

Who We Are:

We’re a $8+ billion, rapidly growing workforce solutions provider in the healthcare industry. We deliver tech-enabled services that help healthcare organizations meet and manage their contingent labor needs. We build and manage tech-enabled marketplaces for national and local healthcare talent and deliver contingent labor management solutions through our proprietary software platform.

At Aya, we’re obsessed with creating exceptional experiences for our clients, clinicians and employees. In fact, we put employee satisfaction above all else. Our team members are responsible for incomparable customer experience and we know that happy employees are critical to maintaining happy clients. We foster an entrepreneurial, high-energy, low-bureaucracy culture and value innovative thinking and creative problem solving. We embrace diversity in thought and backgrounds unified by a commitment to high achievement. When you join Aya, you’ll be surrounded by teammates who care about you as an individual and leaders who will help you grow both personally and professionally.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the credentialing and compliance process for travel healthcare candidates from onboarding through clearance.
  • Review candidate documents for completeness, accuracy, and compliance with facility and Aya requirements.
  • Communicate with candidates, healthcare facilities, recruiters, and internal partners to obtain required documentation and resolve outstanding items.
  • Monitor candidate files, deadlines, and start dates to maintain a strong sense of urgency and support timely clearance.
  • Maintain accurate candidate records and documentation within credentialing and compliance systems.
  • Apply department processes, available resources, and facility requirements to move files forward efficiently.
  • Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve routine credentialing issues while escalating complex concerns appropriately.
  • Manage daily workload and priorities while meeting established KPIs, SLAs, and clearance expectations.
  • Provide coverage for other Credentialing Specialists when needed, including reviewing active files, deadlines, and outstanding requirements.
  • Support team initiatives, process improvements, overflow work, and special projects as business needs arise.
  • Deliver a professional, positive, and solutions-oriented experience in every interaction.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree preferred; equivalent experience considered in lieu of education.
  • Experience in a fast-paced, deadline-driven administrative, healthcare, staffing, credentialing, compliance, or customer service environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while meeting established deadlines and service level expectations.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify missing, inaccurate, or incomplete information.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to build trust and maintain positive relationships with candidates, facilities, and internal partners.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving skills and ability to use available resources effectively.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Comfortable learning and navigating multiple systems and processes.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and the ability to learn credentialing and compliance systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare staffing, travel nursing, travel allied, credentialing, compliance, or a related healthcare environment.
  • Experience working with healthcare providers, candidates, hospitals, or healthcare facilities.
  • Familiarity with credentialing, compliance, onboarding, licensing, or healthcare documentation requirements.
  • Experience managing a high-volume workload in a service-focused environment.

What We Offer:

  • Free premium medical, dental, life and vision insurance
  • Generous 401(k) match
  • Aya also offers other benefits to those that are eligible and where required by applicable law, including reimbursements and discretionary bonuses
  • Aya provides paid sick leave in accordance with all applicable state, federal, and local laws. Aya’s general sick leave policy is that employees accrue one hour of paid sick leave for every 30 hours worked. However, to the extent any provisions of the statement above conflict with any applicable paid sick leave laws, the applicable paid sick leave laws are controlling
  • Celebrations! We hit our goals and reward ourselves
  • Company-sponsored virtual events, happy hours and team-building activities are always on the horizon — plus, you get a special treat on your birthday!
  • Unlimited DTO — we believe in time off!
  • Virtual yoga, meditation or boot camp classes offered daily

Compensation: Aya reasonably anticipates the pay scale for this position to be $28.85 to $35.10 hourly.

The pay scale for this position may vary if applicant possesses experience outside of what Aya reasonably anticipates for this position. Bonuses are subject to the role and your manager’s discretion.

raw.description:
At ASAPP, our mission is simple: deliver the best AI-powered customer experience—faster than anyone else. To achieve that, we're guided by principles that shape how we think, build, and execute. We value customer obsession, purposeful speed, ownership, and a relentless focus on outcomes. We work in tight, skilled teams, prioritize clarity over complexity, and continuously evolve through curiosity, data, and craftsmanship. We're seeking technologists and problem solvers who thrive in fast-paced environments, love collaborating with great talent, and approach every day like it's Day 1.

We're a globally diverse team with hubs in New York City, Mountain View, Latin America, and India. If you're driven by continuous learning, rapid pivots, and the challenges of building in a high-growth startup, we'd love to talk. This is more than a job, it's a journey.

We are looking for a hungry, energetic, and results-driven Sales Executive to join our team, focused on our mid-market segment. Your primary focus will be on accelerating our growth by identifying, pitching, and closing new customer accounts. You will be instrumental in turning prospects into clients, managing the full sales cycle, and driving revenue from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate New Business: Actively seek out new sales opportunities through cold calling, networking, social media (LinkedIn), and lead generation campaigns.
  • Pipeline Management: Build, manage, and maintain a robust sales pipeline, moving leads from initial contact to closed deals.
  • Client Pitching & Demos: Conduct engaging product demonstrations and presentations tailored to the needs of potential clients.
  • Negotiation & Closing: Negotiate contracts, handle objections, and close agreements to meet or exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets.
  • Market Research: Research potential prospects to understand their business needs and identify market gaps.
  • CRM & Reporting: Maintain accurate records of all sales activities in CRM software and provide regular reports on progress and performance.
  • Relationship Building: Develop and nurture relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers (CEOs, managers).

Requirements and Skills

  • Experience: 5+ years of proven success as a Sales Executive (startup experience is a plus), selling SaaS to mid-market software companies. Experience in Customer Experience and/or Contact Center is a plus.
  • Sales Acumen: "Hunter" mentality with a passion for prospecting and closing net-new deals.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills for pitching and negotiation.
  • Tech Savvy: Familiarity with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and MS Office.
  • Results-Oriented: Self-motivated and driven to hit ambitious sales targets.

raw.excerpt: At Colibri, culture is a critical part of our collective success, and we live our values everyday: Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork and Curiosity.
raw.description:
At Colibri, culture is a critical part of our collective success, and we live our values everyday: Love, Joy,
Boldness, Teamwork and Curiosity. These values guide our interactions with each other, our customers,
and the community as a whole.
We have a rich and storied history. Colibri is one of the pioneers of online professional education,
introducing some of the first web-based professional education courses in 2001. Today, the company’s
family of brands are the leading online professional education platforms in their respective end-markets.
We proudly serve >1 million customers annually and employ more than 1,500 mission-aligned
professionals. To learn more, please visit:

Position Overview:

As a core member of the combined Property Professions leadership team, the Single-Threaded Leader (STL) for Pre-License owns the start of the customer relationship. This role owns the end-to-end pre-license outcome for qualifying education across the ecosystem — from acquisition through course completion and licensure — and is accountable for both revenue/contribution and cost.

The role has two inseparable pillars: (1) new-customer acquisition excellence — the modern growth-marketing motion of discovery, funnel, and conversion that wins customers efficiently — and (2) product-experience excellence — the learning experience that keeps students engaged, drives completion, and helps them pass. Together these drive satisfaction and referral and feed the post-license CE, Membership, and Professional Development engine.

This role authors the pre-license engine that every brand runs on, directing matrixed resources from Marketing, Product, Operations, and Shared Services against QE outcomes rather than managing those functions directly.

What You'll Do

    • Own the Pre-License outcome end to end. Own revenue and contribution and manage the cost line across the ecosystem, including enrollment growth, first-attempt pass rate, completion rate, and CAC by channel and state, from acquisition through licensure.
    • Drive new-customer acquisition. Lead the growth-marketing motion — modern discovery (SEO/GEO, content), paid search/social for license intent, conversion rate optimization (CRO), lead-to-enrollment, and referral/partnership channels.
    • Deliver product-experience excellence. Own the student experience that drives engagement and completion, including exam-prep tooling, at-risk intervention, AI tutor/advisor capability, and instructor quality; first-attempt pass rate is the core product promise.
    • Build satisfaction and referral into a growth engine. Design the pre-license experience to drive NPS, referral, and repeat business, seeding the entire downstream customer lifecycle.
    • Own the QE→CE handoff. Jointly own the attach playbook (the 30- to 90-day post-pass welcome, sales, and campaign motion) with the Post-License STL, with the Ecosystem President as tie-breaker on seam disputes. Hand off newly-licensed customers, along with structured student data (completion velocity, exam performance, at-risk signals), to the post-license engine at the point of licensure.
    • Author and standardize the pre-license operating model. Establish a single acquisition → enrollment → completion → pass motion run by national and LDB brands on a shared platform and shared playbooks, keeping the method uniform while allowing brand-level local execution.
    • Deploy AI across the QE workflow. Drive adoption of acquisition AI (bidding, nurture, lead scoring) and outcome AI (at-risk detection, adaptive exam-prep, AI tutor/advisor), tracking AI adoption as an operating metric.
    • Direct matrixed functional resources. Pull resources from Marketing, Product, Operations, and Shared Services against QE outcomes; own the acquisition and product-experience roadmap, channel and budget allocation within the QE P&L, and conversion/pass-rate targets.
    • Maintain 100% state compliance status for pre-license at all times; this is a non-negotiable operating constraint on the role.
    • Run the operating cadence. Lead a weekly review of funnel and outcome metrics (CAC, conversion, completion, pass) and own the QE quarterly plan within the Annual Operating Plan (AOP).
    • Escalate appropriately. Escalate brand-level positioning conflicts, shared-platform tradeoffs, and spend above the agreed threshold to the President, Ecosystem.

What You'll Need to Succeed

    • 12–15+ years in growth, general management, or operations leadership within a high-volume, funnel-driven consumer or prosumer business.
    • Demonstrated ownership of both acquisition and outcome: an acquisition-and-conversion P&L at scale (CAC, conversion, unit economics) combined with ownership of a product or experience that drove completion and outcomes — candidates must show ownership of both, not just one.
    • Growth-marketing fluency across modern discovery/SEO/GEO, paid channels, CRO, and marketing automation, paired with product or experience ownership.
    • Experience in PE-backed or high-accountability environments where execution is measured, reported, and consequential.
    • Preferred: experience with regulated/accredited or state-approved curriculum and multi-state compliance.
    Required Education
    • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Operations, or a related field.
    • MBA or advanced degree preferred.
    Required Technical and Specialized Skills
    • Growth marketing: modern discovery (SEO/GEO, content), SEM/paid social, CRO, marketing automation, CRM pipeline management, partnership marketing.
    • Product and learning experience: LMS/experience design, exam-prep tooling, at-risk analytics, engagement/completion optimization, instructor-quality signal management.
    • Regulatory and compliance operations: 50-state approval/filing for RE and appraiser QE, in partnership with Shared Services Legal & Compliance.
    • Unit economics: CAC by channel/state, conversion economics, and contribution margin at the enrollment level.
    • AI-first deployment: acquisition AI (bidding, nurture, lead scoring), outcome AI (at-risk detection, adaptive exam-prep, AI tutor/advisor), and content AI (authoring with subject-matter-expert validation); ability to size a team AI-first and track adoption as an operating metric.
Colibri Group welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and experiences, and we understand that not every candidate will meet every requirement listed in the job description. Research has shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply to jobs unless they feel they meet every qualification, and we want to actively combat this bias in our hiring process. If you're excited about the role and believe you have the skills and experience to contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply, even if your background doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe that diversity of perspectives and experiences is essential to our success. You may be just the right candidate for this role or another position within our organization. Don't hesitate to take the leap and apply today!

raw.description:
Role Summary

The Chief Legal Officer (CLO) is the senior legal executive responsible for overseeing the organization's legal strategy, governance, regulatory compliance, corporate affairs, and risk management. The CLO serves as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and executive leadership team, ensuring the organization operates within legal and regulatory frameworks while supporting business growth and strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Legal Strategy & Executive Advisory

  • Serve as the principal legal advisor to the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team.
  • Develop and execute the organization's legal strategy in alignment with business objectives.
  • Provide legal guidance on strategic initiatives, mergers and acquisitions, partnerships, and corporate restructuring.
  • Anticipate and mitigate legal risks associated with business operations and growth.

2. Corporate Governance

  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance standards and best practices.
  • Advise the Board and executive leadership on fiduciary responsibilities and governance matters.
  • Manage board resolutions, corporate records, and governance policies.
  • Support corporate secretarial functions where applicable.

3. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Oversee enterprise-wide legal and regulatory compliance programs.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the organization.
  • Develop legal risk mitigation frameworks and compliance controls.

4. Contracts & Commercial Transactions

  • Lead the negotiation, drafting, and review of significant commercial agreements.
  • Oversee contract management processes and legal documentation standards.
  • Provide legal support for strategic partnerships, vendor agreements, and customer contracts.
  • Ensure contractual arrangements adequately protect organizational interests.

5. Litigation & Dispute Resolution

  • Manage litigation strategy and external legal counsel relationships.
  • Oversee dispute resolution, arbitration, mediation, and regulatory investigations.
  • Assess litigation exposure and recommend appropriate legal actions.
  • Ensure effective management of legal claims and liabilities.

6. Mergers, Acquisitions & Corporate Transactions

  • Lead legal due diligence for mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and investments.
  • Structure transactions to minimize legal and regulatory risk.
  • Manage external advisors and legal workstreams throughout transaction lifecycles.
  • Support post-merger integration activities from a legal perspective.

7. Ethics, Compliance & Corporate Integrity

  • Promote a culture of ethics, integrity, and compliance.
  • Oversee whistleblower programs, investigations, and ethics policies.
  • Ensure adherence to anti-corruption, anti-bribery, and corporate conduct standards.
  • Lead internal investigations involving legal and compliance matters.

8. Legal Team Leadership

  • Build and lead a high-performing legal and compliance function.
  • Manage legal budgets and external counsel expenditures.
  • Develop legal talent and succession planning initiatives.
  • Establish legal operations processes and performance metrics.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Juris Doctor (JD), LLB, or equivalent law degree.
  • Licensed attorney admitted to practice in a relevant jurisdiction.
  • 15+ years of progressive legal experience.
  • Minimum 5+ years in a senior legal leadership role (General Counsel, CLO, Head of Legal, Legal Director).
  • Experience advising executive leadership and boards of directors.
  • Strong background in corporate law, governance, compliance, commercial contracts, and regulatory matters.
  • Experience managing complex legal transactions and litigation.

Description

About Us:

At Vertu Agent, we are a high-performance, client-focused firm operating across several industries. We combine innovation, professionalism, and collaboration to deliver exceptional service. Our teams are empowered with the resources, training, and autonomy to exceed client expectations while growing professionally.

Our Culture:

We prioritize excellence, accountability, and continuous learning. Our environment is collaborative yet results-driven, celebrating initiative, problem-solving, and high-impact contributions. Top performers are recognized, mentored, and given opportunities to take on leadership responsibilities.

About the Role

This is not a traditional Executive Assistant or Virtual Assistant position. We are looking for someone who can become a trusted operational right hand to the founder—someone who can take an idea or objective, determine what needs to happen next, and help turn it into execution.

AI proficiency is a key component of this role. The ideal candidate actively uses tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms to research, solve problems, organize information, improve processes, and execute work more efficiently.

You will work across three different business ventures and support a wide variety of initiatives. Because the projects can change frequently, we need someone who is highly adaptable, intellectually curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out without step-by-step instructions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide high-level executive and operational support to the founder across multiple businesses and projects.
  • Turn broad ideas, objectives, and requests into clear action plans and next steps.

raw.excerpt: At Colibri, culture is a critical part of our collective success, and we live our values everyday: Love, Joy, Boldness, Teamwork and Curiosity.
raw.description:
At Colibri, culture is a critical part of our collective success, and we live our values everyday: Love, Joy,
Boldness, Teamwork and Curiosity. These values guide our interactions with each other, our customers,
and the community as a whole.
We have a rich and storied history. Colibri is one of the pioneers of online professional education,
introducing some of the first web-based professional education courses in 2001. Today, the company’s
family of brands are the leading online professional education platforms in their respective end-markets.
We proudly serve >1 million customers annually and employ more than 1,500 mission-aligned
professionals. To learn more, please visit:

Position Overview:

As a core member of the combined Property Professions leadership team, the Single-Threaded Leader (STL) for Pre-License owns the start of the customer relationship. This role owns the end-to-end pre-license outcome for qualifying education across the ecosystem — from acquisition through course completion and licensure — and is accountable for both revenue/contribution and cost.

The role has two inseparable pillars: (1) new-customer acquisition excellence — the modern growth-marketing motion of discovery, funnel, and conversion that wins customers efficiently — and (2) product-experience excellence — the learning experience that keeps students engaged, drives completion, and helps them pass. Together these drive satisfaction and referral and feed the post-license CE, Membership, and Professional Development engine.

This role authors the pre-license engine that every brand runs on, directing matrixed resources from Marketing, Product, Operations, and Shared Services against QE outcomes rather than managing those functions directly.

What You'll Do

    • Own the Pre-License outcome end to end. Own revenue and contribution and manage the cost line across the ecosystem, including enrollment growth, first-attempt pass rate, completion rate, and CAC by channel and state, from acquisition through licensure.
    • Drive new-customer acquisition. Lead the growth-marketing motion — modern discovery (SEO/GEO, content), paid search/social for license intent, conversion rate optimization (CRO), lead-to-enrollment, and referral/partnership channels.
    • Deliver product-experience excellence. Own the student experience that drives engagement and completion, including exam-prep tooling, at-risk intervention, AI tutor/advisor capability, and instructor quality; first-attempt pass rate is the core product promise.
    • Build satisfaction and referral into a growth engine. Design the pre-license experience to drive NPS, referral, and repeat business, seeding the entire downstream customer lifecycle.
    • Own the QE→CE handoff. Jointly own the attach playbook (the 30- to 90-day post-pass welcome, sales, and campaign motion) with the Post-License STL, with the Ecosystem President as tie-breaker on seam disputes. Hand off newly-licensed customers, along with structured student data (completion velocity, exam performance, at-risk signals), to the post-license engine at the point of licensure.
    • Author and standardize the pre-license operating model. Establish a single acquisition → enrollment → completion → pass motion run by national and LDB brands on a shared platform and shared playbooks, keeping the method uniform while allowing brand-level local execution.
    • Deploy AI across the QE workflow. Drive adoption of acquisition AI (bidding, nurture, lead scoring) and outcome AI (at-risk detection, adaptive exam-prep, AI tutor/advisor), tracking AI adoption as an operating metric.
    • Direct matrixed functional resources. Pull resources from Marketing, Product, Operations, and Shared Services against QE outcomes; own the acquisition and product-experience roadmap, channel and budget allocation within the QE P&L, and conversion/pass-rate targets.
    • Maintain 100% state compliance status for pre-license at all times; this is a non-negotiable operating constraint on the role.
    • Run the operating cadence. Lead a weekly review of funnel and outcome metrics (CAC, conversion, completion, pass) and own the QE quarterly plan within the Annual Operating Plan (AOP).
    • Escalate appropriately. Escalate brand-level positioning conflicts, shared-platform tradeoffs, and spend above the agreed threshold to the President, Ecosystem.

What You'll Need to Succeed

    • 12–15+ years in growth, general management, or operations leadership within a high-volume, funnel-driven consumer or prosumer business.
    • Demonstrated ownership of both acquisition and outcome: an acquisition-and-conversion P&L at scale (CAC, conversion, unit economics) combined with ownership of a product or experience that drove completion and outcomes — candidates must show ownership of both, not just one.
    • Growth-marketing fluency across modern discovery/SEO/GEO, paid channels, CRO, and marketing automation, paired with product or experience ownership.
    • Experience in PE-backed or high-accountability environments where execution is measured, reported, and consequential.
    • Preferred: experience with regulated/accredited or state-approved curriculum and multi-state compliance.
    Required Education
    • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Operations, or a related field.
    • MBA or advanced degree preferred.
    Required Technical and Specialized Skills
    • Growth marketing: modern discovery (SEO/GEO, content), SEM/paid social, CRO, marketing automation, CRM pipeline management, partnership marketing.
    • Product and learning experience: LMS/experience design, exam-prep tooling, at-risk analytics, engagement/completion optimization, instructor-quality signal management.
    • Regulatory and compliance operations: 50-state approval/filing for RE and appraiser QE, in partnership with Shared Services Legal & Compliance.
    • Unit economics: CAC by channel/state, conversion economics, and contribution margin at the enrollment level.
    • AI-first deployment: acquisition AI (bidding, nurture, lead scoring), outcome AI (at-risk detection, adaptive exam-prep, AI tutor/advisor), and content AI (authoring with subject-matter-expert validation); ability to size a team AI-first and track adoption as an operating metric.
Colibri Group welcomes applicants from all backgrounds and experiences, and we understand that not every candidate will meet every requirement listed in the job description. Research has shown that women and people of color may be less likely to apply to jobs unless they feel they meet every qualification, and we want to actively combat this bias in our hiring process. If you're excited about the role and believe you have the skills and experience to contribute to our team, we encourage you to apply, even if your background doesn't align perfectly with every qualification listed. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we believe that diversity of perspectives and experiences is essential to our success. You may be just the right candidate for this role or another position within our organization. Don't hesitate to take the leap and apply today!

raw.description:
Role Summary

The Chief Legal Officer (CLO) is the senior legal executive responsible for overseeing the organization's legal strategy, governance, regulatory compliance, corporate affairs, and risk management. The CLO serves as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and executive leadership team, ensuring the organization operates within legal and regulatory frameworks while supporting business growth and strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Legal Strategy & Executive Advisory

  • Serve as the principal legal advisor to the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team.
  • Develop and execute the organization's legal strategy in alignment with business objectives.
  • Provide legal guidance on strategic initiatives, mergers and acquisitions, partnerships, and corporate restructuring.
  • Anticipate and mitigate legal risks associated with business operations and growth.

2. Corporate Governance

  • Ensure compliance with corporate governance standards and best practices.
  • Advise the Board and executive leadership on fiduciary responsibilities and governance matters.
  • Manage board resolutions, corporate records, and governance policies.
  • Support corporate secretarial functions where applicable.

3. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

  • Oversee enterprise-wide legal and regulatory compliance programs.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the organization.
  • Develop legal risk mitigation frameworks and compliance controls.

4. Contracts & Commercial Transactions

  • Lead the negotiation, drafting, and review of significant commercial agreements.
  • Oversee contract management processes and legal documentation standards.
  • Provide legal support for strategic partnerships, vendor agreements, and customer contracts.
  • Ensure contractual arrangements adequately protect organizational interests.

5. Litigation & Dispute Resolution

  • Manage litigation strategy and external legal counsel relationships.
  • Oversee dispute resolution, arbitration, mediation, and regulatory investigations.
  • Assess litigation exposure and recommend appropriate legal actions.
  • Ensure effective management of legal claims and liabilities.

6. Mergers, Acquisitions & Corporate Transactions

  • Lead legal due diligence for mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and investments.
  • Structure transactions to minimize legal and regulatory risk.
  • Manage external advisors and legal workstreams throughout transaction lifecycles.
  • Support post-merger integration activities from a legal perspective.

7. Ethics, Compliance & Corporate Integrity

  • Promote a culture of ethics, integrity, and compliance.
  • Oversee whistleblower programs, investigations, and ethics policies.
  • Ensure adherence to anti-corruption, anti-bribery, and corporate conduct standards.
  • Lead internal investigations involving legal and compliance matters.

8. Legal Team Leadership

  • Build and lead a high-performing legal and compliance function.
  • Manage legal budgets and external counsel expenditures.
  • Develop legal talent and succession planning initiatives.
  • Establish legal operations processes and performance metrics.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Juris Doctor (JD), LLB, or equivalent law degree.
  • Licensed attorney admitted to practice in a relevant jurisdiction.
  • 15+ years of progressive legal experience.
  • Minimum 5+ years in a senior legal leadership role (General Counsel, CLO, Head of Legal, Legal Director).
  • Experience advising executive leadership and boards of directors.
  • Strong background in corporate law, governance, compliance, commercial contracts, and regulatory matters.
  • Experience managing complex legal transactions and litigation.

At Vertu Agent, we are a high-performance, client-focused firm operating across several industries. We combine innovation, professionalism, and collaboration to deliver exceptional service. Our teams are empowered with the resources, training, and autonomy to exceed client expectations while growing professionally.

Our Culture:

We prioritize excellence, accountability, and continuous learning. Our environment is collaborative yet results-driven, celebrating initiative, problem-solving, and high-impact contributions. Top performers are recognized, mentored, and given opportunities to take on leadership responsibilities.

About the Role

This is not a traditional Executive Assistant or Virtual Assistant position. We are looking for someone who can become a trusted operational right hand to the founder—someone who can take an idea or objective, determine what needs to happen next, and help turn it into execution.

AI proficiency is a key component of this role. The ideal candidate actively uses tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms to research, solve problems, organize information, improve processes, and execute work more efficiently.

You will work across three different business ventures and support a wide variety of initiatives. Because the projects can change frequently, we need someone who is highly adaptable, intellectually curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out without step-by-step instructions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide high-level executive and operational support to the founder across multiple businesses and projects.
  • Turn broad ideas, objectives, and requests into clear action plans and next steps.
  • Use AI tools extensively for research, problem-solving, planning, documentation, content development, and workflow optimization.
  • Research unfamiliar topics independently and identify practical solutions, resources, and approaches.
  • Manage and coordinate multiple projects simultaneously, keeping priorities, deadlines, and follow-ups organized.
  • Support new business initiatives, digital projects, email campaigns, research, and other special projects.
  • Assist with operational, administrative, and financial coordination as needed.
  • Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, or improve existing workflows.
  • Coordinate with external vendors, contractors, suppliers, and other stakeholders.
  • Maintain clear documentation and track important decisions, deliverables, and action items.
  • Anticipate potential problems or bottlenecks and proactively recommend solutions.
  • Evaluate different approaches and confidently suggest alternatives when there is a better or more efficient way to accomplish an objective.
  • Take ownership of assignments from initial research through execution and follow-up.

Requirements

  • Previous experience in Executive Assistance, Operations, Project Coordination, Founder Support, or a similar role.
  • Experience working directly with a founder, CEO, entrepreneur, or senior executive is strongly preferred.
  • Strong practical proficiency with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to demonstrate how you have used AI to solve problems, improve workflows, conduct research, or increase productivity.
  • Excellent problem-solving and research abilities.
  • Strong initiative and ability to work independently with limited supervision.
  • Ability to receive an ambiguous objective and independently determine the appropriate next steps.
  • Excellent organizational and project-management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities at the same time.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills (C1,C2)
  • Strong technological aptitude and ability to quickly learn new platforms and systems.
  • Strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
  • Comfortable questioning assumptions, sharing ideas, and recommending better approaches rather than simply following instructions.
  • A strong sense of ownership, accountability, and work ethic.

Compensation

$1,200 - $1,400 per month

Benefits

  • 10 days of per month
  • 3 sick days
  • 6 US Federal Holidays

raw.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

This is a high energy role in which you will bring the Internet of Things to small to medium size customers, building Samsara's business and bringing the benefits of sensor data to customers. Typical sales will be $5k to $20k, and typically involve proof of concepts, multiple stakeholders, multi-faceted pricing negotiations, and selling to owners, safety and operational managers.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara’s top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance Sales culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role, you will:

  • Own customer engagements end-to-end, from prospecting and qualification to close.
  • Generate pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, as well as receive inbound leads from our account development team.
  • Target accounts with 11-30 vehicles.
  • Experience handling and owning transactional sales process with high volume demands.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • 1+ years of experience in a closing sales role

An ideal candidate has:

  • Proven track record of consistent quota achievement
  • Experience selling in the commercial space - small to medium deals sizes
  • Experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Experience in fast-paced, transactional sales
  • Must demonstrate a growth mindset and a willingness to be collaborative with your teammates and in your selling process
  • SFDC familiarity

Annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position is below and depends on your city of residence. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual OTE Salary
$106,050—$151,500 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

raw.description:
Campus Staff Minister -- University of Wisconsin, Madison (Graduate and Faculty Ministry)

Work Location:

Remote - USA

Job Type:

Full timeGod has called InterVarsity to plant and to build witnessing communities of students and faculty who follow Jesus on college and university campuses. Through these groups, we believe ever- increasing numbers of students and faculty from all ethnic groups and areas of the campus will be transformed by the Gospel. We expect to see campuses increasingly become places where people, ideas, and structures flourish to the glory of God. We confidently anticipate that our InterVarsity alumni will become change agents across the country and around the world. We pursue this calling by discerning and actively participating in what God is already doing on campus. This is the essence of being a Campus Staff Minister (CSM).

ESSENTIAL COMMITMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Spiritual Growth

As a Campus Staff Minister, you pursue maturity as a disciple of Jesus Christ so that your life and work increasingly reflecta growing love for God, God’s Word, God’s people of every ethnicity and culture, and God’s purposes in the world. To do this, you will:

  • Pursue a vibrant relationship with the triune God through engagement with Scripture, prayer, and worship, both individually and incommunity

  • Develop self-leadership (growing in self-awareness, self-management, relational integrity, andresiliency)

  • Embrace Scriptural standards for behavior andattitudes

CampusLeadership

As a Campus Staff Minister, you increase the number of witnessing communities, as well as the size, health, spiritual maturity, and campus-wide influence of existing witnessing communities of students and faculty by being a:

  • Visionary Guide:

You communicate and model InterVarsity’s vision to see students and faculty transformed, campuses renewed,and world changers developed

  • Create a culture of humble dependence on God and bold expectation in God’s intention to start new witnessing communities throughout the campus and on new campuses

  • Model – in person and through programs – InterVarsity’s vision and Core Values, including a biblically-defined commitment to engage every ethnic and social group on campus

  • Lead students and faculty – individually and collectively – through Scripture, prayer, teaching, and discipleship experiences, so that they articulate and align their ministry activities around this vision

  • Set annual goals through prayer, researchand reflection with your teams (students, faculty, and staff) for qualitative and quantitative growth, including conversions and leadershipdevelopment

  • Structural Architect:

You create, develop, align, and leverage ministry plans, programs, teams, and structures to close the gap between current reality and the aspirational goals.

  • Build leadership teams who trust and partner well with you and who demonstrate spiritual vitality, relational health, and missionalignment

  • Develop and execute plans to achieve annual goals, evaluating and modifyingthe plan as needed throughout the year

  • Increase momentum for the vision by aligning programs, structures, conferences, and teams around the goals

  • Mobilize students and faculty to engage their relational networks with the gospel and to start new missionalcommunities

  • Under the direction of the Area Director, may supervise Ministry Interns and Campus Ministry Interns as delegated

  • Missional Developer:

You intentionally gather, invite, and develop diverse groups of students and faculty sothattheynotonlyencounterandfollowJesusasSaviorandLordbutalsoadvance the mission on campus as participants andleaders.

  • Create ways for faculty and students to encounterand follow Jesus through Scripture, worship, prayer, mission experiences, conferences, etc.

  • Equip students and faculty so that they think strategically about campus engagement and so that they proclaim – in word, deed, and power – the good news of Jesus, regularly inviting students and faculty to follow him as Savior and Lord

  • Disciple students and faculty by equipping them to hear the Word, respond actively, and debrief and interpret the experience so that they grow in Christlikeness, reflect our Core Values, and develop ministryskills

  • Invite, coach, and equip students and faculty to become increasingly effective participants and leaders, including starting new witnessing communities on campuses

Organizational Collaboration

As a Campus Staff Minister, you have joined a national mission. Therefore, you work with a network of other local, area, regional, and national InterVarsity staff and volunteers so that our work reflects Biblical standards of excellence, integrity, and partnership.

  • Partner with and respond positively to the direction and coaching of your supervisors and nationalleaders

  • Contribute to collaborative and productive team meetings and relationships

  • Affiliate chapters under your care and submit Graduating Student Forms in order toincrease our partnership with current students and alumni

  • Use national ministry resources and tools, as requested, including recruiting and/or participatingin local, regional, or national conferences as required

  • Complete reporting, planningand review requirements in a timelyway so that you and your supervisors can assess and improve your work as a CSM

  • Comply with all InterVarsity policies and procedures

Ministry Partnership Development

As a Campus Staff Minister, you will develop a team of partners – churches and individuals (including alumni and community members) – who will resource the ministry financially, in prayer, or volunteer service that advances the mission.

  • Raise 100% of the financial budget assigned by yoursupervisor

  • Communicate regularly with your ministry partners, nurturing the relationship through visits, phone calls, emailsand regular prayer letters

  • Develop on-going, long-lasting partnership with alumni and volunteers

  • Comply with all Ministry PartnershipPolicies

  • Identify and invest in advocates who will build networks of volunteers and donors on InterVarsity’sbehalf

Accomplish all other assigned tasks as appropriate

QUALIFICATIONS (common to all levels of CSM)

  • Annually affirm InterVarsity’s Statement of Agreement (Doctrinal Basis and Purpose Statement). Abide by InterVarsity’s Code of Conduct. Believe and behave consonantly with InterVarsity’s Human Sexuality Theological Paper. Affirm and behave consonantly with InterVarsity’s “Women in Ministry Statement of Affirmation”

  • Bachelor’s degree requiredfor CSMs assigned to a four-year campus. A minimum of an Associate’sdegree requiredfor CSMs assigned to a two-year campus or a community college

  • Strong interpersonal skills (including ability to minister to diverse ethnic communities and faculty)

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Demonstrated problem solving skills

  • Familiarity with word processing, presentation, email, and spreadsheetsoftware

WORK ENVIRONMENT/PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

The CSM position leads ministry in a college campus environment. A designated office space may or may not be available. The CSM is required to travel to on-campus and off- campus sites as appropriate. Off-campus travel includes, but is not limited to: student ministry conferences, Ministry Partnership Development meetings, and InterVarsity- sponsored training sessions, meetings, and conferences. The CSM is regularly required to communicate with others, and routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, filing cabinets, etc.

Pay Range: $40,476.00 - $53,952.00 per year

Pay: This position is funded through personal fundraising. Accordingly, compensation will vary based on the ability of the individual to secure a donor team to fund the cost of his/her salary. The anticipated salary range for this position on a full-time basis (40 hours/week) is dependent on a variety of factors, including location and cost of living. The actual salary received,including any geographic adjustment to account for location and cost of living, is subject to the individual’s ability to raise funds necessary to cover the full amount of such salary within the range set forth in the job posting details.

Benefits:

We offer a competitive benefits package, including health care and retirement savings with a match. Eligibility is based on employee type and hours worked. Benefits include the following:

  • 403(b) Retirement Savings Plan

  • 403(b) matching contributions

  • Dental insurance

  • Employee assistance program

  • Employee discounts

  • Flexible work schedule

  • Flexible spending accounts

  • Health insurance

  • Health savings account

  • Life insurance

  • Paid time off

  • Parental leave

  • Professional development assistance

  • Vision insurance

Equal Employment Opportunity:

InterVarsity Christian Fellowship/USA is both an equal opportunity employer and a faith-based religious organization. We conduct hiring without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age, sex, marital status, parental status, membership in any labor organization, political ideology, or disability of an otherwise qualified individual. The status of InterVarsity Christian Fellowship/USA as an equal opportunity employer does not prevent the organization from hiring staff based on their religious beliefs so that all staff share the same religious commitment.  Pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e 1(a)) InterVarsity Christian Fellowship/USA has the right to, and does, hire only candidates who agree with InterVarsity’s Statement of Agreement: Purpose and Doctrinal Basisbecause InterVarsity believes that each and every staff plays a vital role in advancing InterVarsity’s mission and purposes.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Salary Range: $80,000–$100,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

We are looking for an AppSec Engineer to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle, partnering with engineering teams to design secure systems, identify vulnerabilities, and reduce risk across our application portfolio. The role blends hands-on offensive and defensive skills with strong communication and collaboration, helping development teams build secure software efficiently rather than slowing them down.
