Why Keyrus, Why Now!

A Keyrus é um grupo internacional com 2.800 consultores e especialistas em 28 países, construído sobre uma convicção: a IA não transforma empresas. A inteligência arquitetada transforma.
Há mais de 30 anos, construímos as bases de dados que tornam os sistemas inteligentes possíveis, projetando o Sistema Operacional da Empresa Inteligente, onde a inteligência está incorporada ao núcleo dos processos de negócio para criar valor sustentável: operacionalizamos a inteligência.

A IA não substitui os seres humanos. Ela nos reposiciona em um lugar que nenhum sistema pode alcançar: compreender, decidir, criar e inovar.
Na Keyrus, você não desenvolverá apenas habilidades; desenvolverá discernimento. Sua expertise se fortalece a cada sistema que você projeta, a cada desafio de negócio que ajuda a resolver e a cada implementação que evolui a partir dos aprendizados anteriores.

Com o tempo, você se tornará um dos profissionais mais raros da era da inteligência: alguém capaz de conectar dados, IA e tomada de decisão humana em escala, entre diferentessetores, mercados e geografias.
Esta não é apenas uma posição. É uma disciplina que você domina e uma história que ajuda a escrever para se tornar um Arquiteto da Inteligência da Keyrus.

A tecnologia amplia capacidades. A cultura da Keyrus diferencia. A excelência na execução conecta ambas.

O QUE VOCÊ IRÁ ARQUITETAR

Esta posição combina visão arquitetural, profundidade técnica e atuação consultiva. Buscamos profissionais capazes de transformar desafios complexos em soluções de dados escaláveis, modernas e orientadas a resultados.


QUEM VOCÊ É

Você é um profissional experiente que combina conhecimento técnico com visão estratégica de negócio.

Você entende que dados são a base para decisões mais inteligentes e para a transformação das organizações.

Você consegue navegar com naturalidade entre discussões arquiteturais, implementação técnica e relacionamento com stakeholders.

Você gosta de estruturar ambientes complexos, criar padrões e impulsionar a evolução tecnológica.

Você equilibra pragmatismo e inovação, priorizando soluções que geram impacto real.

Você compartilha conhecimento e contribui para o crescimento técnico das equipes ao seu redor.

Você possui perfil consultivo, analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.

O QUE VOCÊ TRAZ

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Python Pleno/Sênior para atuar em um projeto desafiador na área de Data & Analytics, desenvolvendo soluções voltadas à hiperautomação e ingestão de dados.

Você fará parte de um time responsável pelo desenvolvimento de uma plataforma de ingestão e consolidação de informações provenientes de aproximadamente 30 parceiros, com potencial de expansão para 60. O ambiente envolve diferentes fontes, formatos e volumes de dados, como APIs, XLSX, CSV, TXT, PDF e Web Scraping.

O desenvolvimento será realizado majoritariamente utilizando Python, com foco na construção de soluções escaláveis, integrações, automações e processamento de dados.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver automações, APIs, aplicações, integrações e pipelines utilizando Python;

  • Desenvolver rotinas de ingestão, processamento e tratamento de dados provenientes de diferentes fontes e formatos;

  • Implementar soluções para processamento de diferentes volumes de dados, considerando performance, escalabilidade e estratégias incrementais;

  • Projetar e evoluir soluções técnicas de acordo com os padrões e arquitetura definidos para o projeto;

  • Desenvolver componentes reutilizáveis, serviços e integrações para soluções de hiperautomação;

  • Realizar testes unitários, apoiar homologações e atuar na correção de defeitos e incidentes;

  • Participar e contribuir com code reviews e melhoria contínua da qualidade do código;

  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para garantir entregas alinhadas aos requisitos funcionais e técnicos;

  • Para profissionais mais experientes, atuar na definição de padrões, boas práticas e decisões técnicas da solução;

  • Apoiar tecnicamente outros desenvolvedores e contribuir para a evolução técnica do time;

  • Participar da avaliação de riscos técnicos, otimização de performance e evolução contínua das aplicações.

Requisitos

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Python;

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de APIs e integrações entre sistemas;

  • Experiência com automação de processos;

  • Experiência com ingestão, tratamento e processamento de dados;

  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de desenvolvimento e qualidade de código;

  • Experiência com testes e versionamento de código.

    Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com Snowflake;

  • Experiência em projetos de Hiperautomação;

  • Experiência com processamento de grandes volumes de dados;

  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas incrementais e/ou streaming;

  • Experiência com otimização de performance e escalabilidade de aplicações;

  • Experiência com liderança ou mentoria técnica de outros desenvolvedores.

O QUE FARÁ VOCÊ TER SUCESSO

Excelente capacidade de comunicação com públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
Facilidade para transformar necessidades de negócio em soluções práticas e escaláveis.
Capacidade de influenciar decisões e construir relacionamentos de confiança com stakeholders.
Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.
Foco na geração de valor e resultados para clientes e negócios.
Colaboração, compartilhamento de conhecimento e melhoria contínua como parte da sua forma de trabalhar.

NOSSOS VALORES

Inteligência Coletiva

A colaboração entre diferentes especialidades, funções e geografias nos permite combinar conhecimento e entregar respostas mais completas para os desafios dos nossos clientes.

Confiabilidade

A capacidade de entregar projetos complexos com rigor, qualidade e consistência é um dos pilares da nossa relação com clientes e parceiros.

Pragmatismo

Priorizamos impacto concreto e valor mensurável acima de discursos tecnológicos abstratos.

Espírito Empreendedor

Curiosidade, energia, autonomia e iniciativa são a base da nossa cultura e impulsionam a inovação contínua.


ABOUT KEYRUS

Na Keyrus, ajudamos as organizações a evoluir da IA experimental para a IA industrializada, de agentes isolados para sistemas orquestrados e de insights para execução.

Essa é a disciplina que chamamos de Architect of Intelligence: desenhar o sistema operacional da empresa inteligente, onde a inteligência está incorporada aos processos de negócio para criar valor sustentável.

Impulsionados pelo nosso modelo proprietário Human Orchestrated Model™ (HOM), estruturamos fundações de inteligência, governança centrada no ser humano e direcionamento de performance para criar ambientes inteligentes onde a tecnologia amplia as capacidades humanas.

Com mais de 30 anos de experiência e 2.800 colaboradores distribuídos em 28 países, ajudamos organizações a ir além da transformação, construindo empresas adaptáveis, resilientes e em constante evolução.

A IA não transforma negócios. A inteligência arquitetada transforma.

Vem fazer parte do Time Keyrus!

Para mais informações: www.keyrus.com.br

raw.description:
Are you ready to drive growth and secure top-tier enterprise accounts in a high-impact territory? As an Enterprise Account Executive at Rapid7, you will lead strategic revenue expansion across key accounts while partnering with channel allies to penetrate greenfield opportunities. This is a quota-carrying role critical to advancing our mission and scaling our presence in the Mid-Atlantic region. While this position is fully remote, we are specifically seeking candidates located within the Greater Boston or Greater Pittsburgh regions.

About the Team

Our Enterprise Sales team partners cross-functionally to ensure strategic clients maximize their return on investment while driving sustainable revenue growth. We collaborate closely with internal experts and regional partners to deliver customer value and expand market footprint.

About the Role

As an Enterprise Account Executive, your primary responsibility will be to grow Rapid7’s top revenue-generating enterprise customers and expand greenfield market share within the Pittsburgh region. Specifically, your focus will be to:

  • Manage and nurture strategic relationships with key customer accounts and subsidiaries in the Pittsburgh area.

  • Drive net new sales expansion and lead complex renewal processes across the Large Enterprise segment.

  • Build and cultivate strong long-term relationships with key regional channel partners.

  • Partner cross-functionally with Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Sales Operations, and Executive Leadership to ensure account health and customer retention.

  • Lead executive business reviews with top strategic accounts to assess satisfaction and surface expansion opportunities.

  • Initiate renewal discussions 4 to 6 months in advance to safeguard existing revenue streams.

  • Establish comprehensive account success plans in close alignment with Customer Success.

  • Maintain accurate system records, opportunity pipelines, and sales forecasts in Salesforce.

The skills and qualities you'll bring include:

  • Proven track record with 5+ years of experience selling enterprise software solutions within the cybersecurity industry.

  • Demonstrated background with 3+ years of success leveraging channel partners to close enterprise deals.

  • Strong technical acumen and broad understanding of the cybersecurity ecosystem and client selection criteria.

  • Deep experience navigating complex, matrixed enterprise organizations (1,500+ employees) to drive consensus and revenue.

  • Expertise managing both net new business acquisition and multi-year renewal lifecycles in large enterprise accounts.

  • Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills suited for C-level executive interactions.

  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 25% for client and partner meetings as needed.

  • Ability to build a global network and work across internal boundaries (CS, SE, Sales Ops) to deliver sustainable customer outcomes (Cross-Functional Collaboration).

  • Habit of taking full ownership of revenue targets and establishing clear expectations across internal resources to drive outcomes (Accountability).

  • Capability to make efficient decisions in complex sales cycles, integrating diverse perspectives to maintain momentum (Decision-Making).

  • Strong self-awareness to adapt to changing client dynamics and navigate complex organizational structures effectively (Self-Awareness).

  • Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success.

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That’s because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don’t be shy - apply today.


About Rapid7

At Rapid7, our vision is to create a secure digital world for our customers, our industry, and our communities. We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what’s possible and drive extraordinary impact. We’re building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome.


Protecting 11,500+ customers against bad actors and threats means we’re continuing to push the envelope just like we’ ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you ’re ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we’re ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.


Rapid7, Inc. is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. We evaluate compensation decisions on a case-by-case basis, and it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the very top of the salary range.


The annual salary range for this role, depending on location, is:

United States: $119,900.00 - 162,200.00 USD Annual

Salary ranges may vary based on geographical location. This range does not include variable/incentive compensation, equity and benefits (where applicable/eligible).

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state or local law.

raw.description:
Team Segment : Music

Team Information :
The main aim of the Data Platform team is leveraging data to provide insights and evidence to help stakeholders take meaningful business actions. With the help of key findings and reports from the team, the Business Leader will be all set to make informed decisions.

In addition to supporting data-driven decision making, the team is also responsible for the development and ongoing operation of personalized recommendation systems. By integrating machine learning models—such as those powered by AWS Personalize—into our data platform, we aim to enhance user experiences through intelligent and scalable content recommendations, including music recommendation features in the near future.

If you’re passionate about leveraging data to drive business and deliver personalized user experiences, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement ETL/ELT processes to integrate data from a variety of internal and external sources into an analytical-based data model to support business analytics or product development.
  • Develop procedures for tracking data quality, completeness, redundancy, and improvement.
  • Work closely with data analysts and development teams to implement solutions that enable them to do their jobs.
  • Build and optimize recommendation pipelines, including implementing models using AWS Personalize for personalized content ranking and user-item interaction prediction.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to explore and prototype personalized recommendation systems, especially in the context of music content delivery.
  • Contribute to strategic initiatives involving machine learning-driven personalization systems, with a focus on increasing product engagement through recommendation accuracy.

Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience in building and operating large-scale distributed systems or applications.
  • Strong programming skills in one or more of the following languages: Python / Scala / PySpark / SparkSQL.
  • Experience in ETL or ELT (designing, coding, and tuning data processes from various sources).
  • Experience in implementing machine learning algorithms.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Personalize or similar recommendation engines.
  • Experience with cloud solutions like AWS or GCP.
  • Experience with tech stack tools such as Airflow / Jenkins.
  • Strong interest or prior experience in music recommendation systems or personalization use cases.
  • Team-oriented, open-minded, communicative and eager to learn.
  • A proactive, data-driven and logical mindset.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in container technology, such as Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience in backend system design and API development.
  • Experience in evaluating recommendation systems through offline metrics and online A/B testing.

Financial & Resource Stewardship

Risk, Change & Benefits Realization

Stakeholder & Relationship Management

  • Drive Client Referenceability and Case Studies

What You Will Likely Bring:

  • 10+ years’ experience in program/project management, with at least 5 years in ERP delivery
  • Demonstrated success managing billable programs with strong utilization and profitability performance
  • Proven ability to lead large-scale ERP portfolios and programs in global environments.

What Could Set You Apart:

  • Commercial Acumen: Skilled in managing billable utilisation, forecasting, and program profitability
  • Strategic Alignment: Ability to translate customer strategies into actionable ERP portfolio initiatives
  • Identification of opportunities to expand the Epicor footprint in the client organisation
  • Analytical Capability: Proficient in portfolio/program analysis and decision-making
  • Change Management: Skilled in adoption and cultural transformation across ERP programs
  • Communication: Strong executive presentation and negotiation skills
  • Agility: Effective in hybrid delivery models (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid)

About Epicor

At Epicor, we’re truly a team. Join 5,000talented professionals in creating a world of better business through data, AI, and cognitive ERP. We help businesses stay future-ready by connecting people, processes, and technology. From software engineers who command the latest AI technology to business development reps who help us seize new opportunities, the work we do matters. Together, Epicor employees are creating a more resilient global supply chain.

We’re Proactive, Proud, Partners.

Whatever your career journey, we’ll help you find the right path. Through our training courses, mentorship, and continuous support, you’ll get everything you need to thrive. At Epicor, your success is our success. And that success really matters, because we’re the essential partners for the world’s most essential businesses—the hardworking companies who make, move, and sell the things the world needs.

Competitive Pay & Benefits

  • Work-Life Balance: Policies built on mutual trust and support, encouraging time off to rest, recharge, and reconnect.

Equal Opportunities and Accommodations Statement 

Epicor is committed to creating a workplace and global community where inclusion is valued; where you bring the whole and real you—that’s who we’re interested in. If you have interest in this or any role- but your experience doesn’t match every qualification of the job description, that’s okay- consider applying regardless. 

We are an equal-opportunity employer.

Minimum: $120,000 USD Maximum: $204,000 USD

Client Success Manager, Legal (Profitability)

Remote or Hybrid (US)

About the role

The Client Success Manager, Legal is an individual contributor on Intapp’s Client Success Legal Industry team, responsible for driving adoption and solution optimization across a tier of accounts. You will proactively guide clients to unlock the value of their investment in Intapp products. This role is a generalist across Intapp's product suite with depth of expertise in Intapp Time and Billstream and the broader timekeeping, billing, and profitability domain in law firms.

Success in this role turns clients into long-term partners — firms that are fully realizing their Intapp investment, expanding what they do with the platform, and influencing peers in their markets. The Client Success Manager operates as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders and serves as the voice of the customer internally to our product and account teams.

What You Will Do:

  • Monitor adoption data, usage trends, health and engagement signals across a tier of legal clients to identify where proactive outreach will drive retention and value.

  • Execute data-triggered success plays — structured, repeatable outreach motions tied to usage milestones, risk signals, or renewal timing — to drive adoption and retention at scale.

  • Leverage skills, expertise, and client feedback to identify and build new success plays to drive incremental value for our clients.

  • Serve as a responsive point of contact for client inquiries, advising on product usage, configuration, and best practices.

  • Build proficiency in an initial Intapp solution, then progressively expand expertise across the broader Intapp product suite.

  • Consult with clients post-deployment to ensure they capitalize on available solution features and that implemented solutions meet their organizational needs.

  • Reinforce and expand knowledge of Intapp's product portfolio, competitive landscape, and industry dynamics on an ongoing basis.

What You Will Need:

  • 5+ years of experience in client success serving professional services firms, ideally in the legal industry.

  • Experience using adoption and usage data to drive structured, playbook-driven outreach programs.

  • Ability to build product proficiency quickly and continue learning new solutions over time.

  • Exposure or experience with Intapp Time and Billstream or the timekeeping, billing, and profitability domain in law or professional service firms.

  • Strong consultative and communication skills: ability to listen carefully and influence.

  • Strong analytical skills and ability to synthesize input from multiple sources into clear client-facing recommendations.

  • Resourceful problem-solver with results orientation and strong time management discipline.

  • Bachelor’s degree required.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with professional services firms, ideally law firms, and how they operate.

  • Experience across Intapp's broader product suite, or equivalent enterprise software in the professional services space.

  • Experience with customer success or engagement platforms used to trigger and track outreach at scale.

  • Experience in a publicly traded, growth-stage software company.

What You Will Gain at Intapp

At Intapp, you'll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. You'll be part of a growing public company, with a modern work environment that's connected yet flexible and where your professional growth and well-being are top priorities. We'll collaborate and grow together, supporting each other in a positive, open atmosphere that fosters creativity, innovation, and teamwork.

Here, you will have the opportunity to:

Expand Your Skills: Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career.

Enjoy Where You Work: Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energized throughout the day.

Support What Matters Most: Our comprehensive wellness and flexible time off programs and our benefits are designed to care for you and your family. Our family-formation benefits and support during your family-building journey ensure you have the resources you need when it matters most. We believe in giving back and supporting our communities with paid volunteer time off and a donation matching program for the causes you care about.

Join us and be a part of a collaborative and welcoming culture where your contributions are valued, and your professional growth is a priority. Together, we are building a company of long-term value that we can all be proud of.

The ideal candidate combines a new-business mindset with strategic account growth skills—equally comfortable prospecting into new organizations, developing complex opportunities, and expanding relationships within established “key” accounts.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities, building relationships with cybersecurity, IT, procurement, and executive stakeholders
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans for Key Accounts, identifying whitespace, new use cases, and opportunities to expand Recorded Future’s footprint

About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

The Service Delivery Manager is responsible for coordinating the successful delivery of customer projects and service engagements by aligning resource capacity with customer demand, driving project execution, and ensuring delivery commitments are met. This role serves as the operational hub between customers, delivery teams, project resources, and leadership to ensure projects are properly staffed, risks are proactively managed, and customer expectations are consistently achieved.

The Service Delivery Manager oversees project governance, resource planning, meeting facilitation, action item management, and escalation resolution while maintaining visibility into project health, resource utilization, timelines, budgets, and overall customer satisfaction.

You will lead end-to-end delivery of Palantir-based programs, ensuring alignment between stakeholders, timelines, and technical teams.

Role Description

Resource Management & Capacity Planning

  • Maintain visibility into all available service delivery resources and project assignments.

  • Align inbound project demand with available resource capacity and skill sets.

  • Coordinate resource assignments across multiple customer engagements and projects.

  • Monitor resource utilization and recommend adjustments to optimize delivery performance.

  • Identify resource constraints and skill gaps and develop mitigation plans.

  • Partner with delivery leaders and functional managers on staffing priorities and future resource needs.

Project Delivery & Execution

  • Track all incoming projects and service engagements from initiation through completion.

  • Ensure projects are appropriately staffed and aligned to customer requirements.

  • Monitor project schedules, milestones, budgets, risks, and deliverables.

  • Facilitate project status meetings, delivery reviews, and customer update meetings.

  • Ensure projects remain on track and proactively address obstacles impacting delivery.

  • Support project teams in developing and executing recovery plans when necessary.

Governance & Accountability

  • Facilitate recurring project and operational review meetings.

  • Document meeting outcomes, decisions, action items, owners, and due dates.

  • Distribute meeting notes within established timelines.

  • Track action items through completion and hold stakeholders accountable for commitments.

  • Maintain project dashboards, status reports, risk logs, and delivery metrics.

  • Ensure consistent adherence to delivery processes and governance standards.

Risk & Escalation Management

  • Identify and manage project risks related to scope, budget, timeline, resources, and technical dependencies.

  • Maintain risk and issue logs for active projects.

  • Work with project teams to develop mitigation plans and corrective actions.

  • Serve as the primary escalation point for project delivery and resource-related issues.

  • Drive issue resolution while maintaining alignment among stakeholders.

  • Escalate significant risks and concerns to leadership when appropriate.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong working relationships with customer stakeholders and internal teams.

  • Provide clear communication regarding project status, risks, resource challenges, and delivery commitments.

  • Facilitate discussions to resolve competing priorities and delivery challenges.

  • Support customer satisfaction through proactive communication and successful execution.

  • Ensure customer expectations are aligned with project objectives and delivery capabilities.

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Teamwork: Can work effectively in a team, contributing ideas and effort, and respecting the contributions of others.

  • Customer Service: Can identify customer needs, propose suitable solutions, and handle more complex customer interactions.

  • Organization: Can prioritize daily tasks, manage personal workflow, and utilize basic tools to keep track of responsibilities.

  • Time Management: Can generally use time effectively but may occasionally struggle with prioritizing tasks, meeting deadlines, or maintaining work-life balance.

  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information, and can adapt communication style to the audience.

  • Analytical Thinking: Can apply critical thinking to analyze data, identify patterns, and make basic inferences.

  • Problem-Solving: Can identify problems, propose solutions, and take action to resolve them without explicit instructions.

  • Detail-Oriented: Can identify errors or inconsistencies in work and make necessary corrections.

  • Presenting: Can prepare and deliver presentations, addressing key points and responding to questions with clarity.

  • Self-Motivation: Can identify personal or professional growth opportunities, propose self-improvement strategies, and take action without explicit instructions.

  • Negotiation: Can identify opportunities for compromise, propose solutions, and take action to influence outcomes without explicit instructions.

  • Initiative: Can identify opportunities for improvement, propose solutions, and take action without explicit instructions.

  • Consultative Sales: Can identify customer needs, propose suitable products or services, and take action to close sales without explicit instructions.

Skill Level Requirements

  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and competing priorities.

  • Experience with resource planning and capacity management.

  • Strong understanding of project governance, risk management, and stakeholder communications.

  • Experience supporting customer-facing delivery organizations.

  • Resource Management and Workforce Planning

  • Project and Program Management

  • Meeting Facilitation

  • Risk and Issue Management

  • Executive Communication

  • Customer Relationship Management

  • Escalation Management

  • Conflict Resolution

  • Organizational and Planning Skills

Other Requirements

  • Completed Bachelor’s Degree or relevant work experience required

  • 5+ years of project management, service delivery, or operations management experience.

  • Experience managing technical/data projects

  • Experience with Palantir or similar platforms

  • Ability to travel to SHI, Partner, and Customer Events

Equal Employment Opportunity – M/F/Disability/Protected Veteran Status

We're seeking a skilled Webflow Developer to craft responsive, pixel-perfect websites and landing pages. You'll collaborate with our growth and product teams to optimize our site for conversions, SEO, and seamless integrations. This remote role suits India-based talent passionate about no-code development and AI-driven businesses.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build dynamic Webflow sites, including landing pages, blogs, and client portals using Webflow's CMS and animations.
  • Integrate third-party tools like HubSpot, Google Analytics, Zapier, and custom JavaScript for enhanced functionality.
  • Optimize sites for SEO, speed, and mobile responsiveness using Semrush and Google tools.
  • Collaborate on A/B tests and CRO experiments to boost user engagement.
  • Troubleshoot and maintain sites with HTML/CSS/JS tweaks and Figma handoffs.
  • Support marketing campaigns with rapid page deployments.
  • Integrate AI Capabilities: Connect Webflow projects with Large Language Model (LLM) APIs (specifically OpenAI/ChatGPT) to build dynamic, AI-powered user experiences.
  • API Optimization: Architect AI workflows to optimize for latency, token consumption, and cost-efficiency, ensuring fast and reliable responses.
  • Component Development: Understanding of Storybook for building, testing, and documenting UI components in isolation is a plus.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of hands-on Webflow experience (certified preferred).
  • 4+ years of Javascript experience and 2+ years of react.
  • 2+ years of GSAP animation experience
  • Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and Webflow Logic/CMS.
  • Experience with SEO tools (Semrush/Google Analytics), integrations (Zapier/HubSpot), and design tools (Figma).
  • Strong understanding of responsive design, performance optimization, and CRO best practices.
  • AI API Integration: Proven experience implementing and managing integrations with AI models like ChatGPT/OpenAI in web applications.
  • Technical Optimization: Strong understanding of how to optimize AI API calls, including handling rate limits, caching strategies, and minimizing latency.
  • Cloud Exposure: Basic exposure to AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), specifically understanding concepts like storing secrets or simple script hosting.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Fully remote work with flexible hours and home office stipend.
  • Opportunity to shape a high-growth AI startup and work with cutting-edge tech.

raw.title: Jr Investigator, Program Integrity
raw.excerpt: Your Future Evolves HereEvolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions.
raw.description:
Your Future Evolves Here

Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones.

Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business.

Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture.

What You’ll Be Doing:

Put your passion where it meets purpose! Evolent attracts some of the brightest minds in health care. Surround yourself with talented, driven colleagues who share a passion for better health outcomes and a more connected care journey. We are hiring a Junior Investigator to join our Program Integrity Unit.

Evolent’s Program Integrity Unit works closely with our health plan clients to identify, reduce and eliminate health care fraud, waste and abuse.

Collaboration Opportunities:

The SIU Junior Investigator works closely with investigators and SIU leadership to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant handling of investigative activities while maintaining confidentiality of sensitive information.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Investigative Support

  • Perform preliminary research utilizing internal and external databases to identify potential indicators of Fraud, Waste, and Abuse.
  • Assist investigators in the development and progression of investigations.
  • Gather, compile, and organize investigative information from multiple data sources.
  • Identify potential investigative leads and trends from Health Care Fraud Prevention Partnership (HFPP) memoranda, referrals, and other sources.
  • Conduct preliminary reviews of provider, member, and claims information to support case development.
  • Gather and review data in response to inquiries received by the Special Investigations Unit.

Data Analysis and Case Development

  • Utilize claims and analytical databases to retrieve and review claims data.
  • Review claims, utilization, and payment data for aberrancies, patterns, trends, and anomalies that may warrant further investigation.
  • Assist in analyzing data to support investigative findings and recommendations.
  • Prepare summaries of research findings and investigative observations for review by SIU investigators and leadership.

Documentation and Case Management

  • Document investigative activities, findings, and case updates within the SIU case management system.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and timely records for assigned cases and referrals on the internal site.
  • Prepare correspondence and supporting documentation in accordance with departmental procedures.
  • Maintain up-to-date notes and documentation on assigned projects.

Provider Communication and Outreach Support

  • Utilize approved electronic vendor platforms to distribute outbound correspondence to providers.
  • Assist with tracking provider responses and maintaining communication records.

Operational and Administrative Support

  • Monitor and track workflow activities to ensure timely completion of assigned tasks.
  • Participate in SIU meetings and contribute to operational discussions and investigative planning.
  • Maintain confidentiality of sensitive investigative, member, provider, and organizational information.
  • Stay current on Fraud, Waste, and Abuse trends, regulations, and investigative best practices.
  • Perform other duties, projects, and assignments as requested.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to identify trends, anomalies, and potential indicators of Fraud, Waste, and Abuse.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to research information from multiple sources (governmental, regulatory, health plan).
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • Ability to learn and utilize investigative, claims, and case management systems.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality and handle sensitive information appropriately.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet established deadlines.

Qualifications (Required and Preferred):

  • One (1) to three (3) years of experience in healthcare operations, claims analysis, fraud detection, compliance, auditing, investigations, data analysis, or a related field preferred.
  • Experience working with healthcare claims, provider data, or medical records.
  • Basic understanding of healthcare fraud, waste, and abuse concepts.
  • Bachelor's degree in criminal justice, Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Finance, Health Information Management, or a related field; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience with healthcare claims processing, SIU operations, compliance, auditing, or investigative support.
  • Experience using claims databases, data analytics tools, or case management systems.
  • Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Accredited Healthcare Fraud Investigator (AHFI)

Working Relationships:

The SIU Junior Investigator works collaboratively with SIU investigators, compliance personnel, legal teams, operational departments, network management teams, and external partners to support investigative activities and organizational efforts to detect, prevent, and address Fraud, Waste, and Abuse.

To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in-person I-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration.

Technical Requirements:

We require that all employees have the following technical capability at their home: High speed internet over 10 Mbps and, specifically for all call center employees, the ability to plug in directly to the home internet router.

Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact for further assistance.

The expected base salary/wage range for this position is $50,000. As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

The world the mission operates in is going post-quantum, contested, and machine-speed. Quantum Sky engineers the advantage across cyber, networks, software, and quantum because the mission demands dominance, not parity. We don't follow the map. We draw it.

At Quantum Sky, we believe that success starts with our people. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and mission-driven environment where every team member plays a critical role in shaping the future of technology. Are you ready to join #TeamQuantumSky?

Make an Impact with Data That Drives Global Education

At Keypath Education, we're transforming lives through education. As a global EdTech leader, we partner with leading universities across Australia and South East Asia to deliver innovative online learning experiences.

We're seeking a commercially minded Data Intelligence Analyst to turn complex data into meaningful insights that drive business performance. Leveraging your expertise in Power BI, SQL, and data modelling, you'll create impactful dashboards and reporting solutions that support decision-making across marketing, student growth, revenue, and business strategy.

Working as part of our APAC Strategy & Insights team, you'll collaborate with stakeholders across the business to uncover opportunities, influence decisions, and champion data-driven thinking.

Why Join Keypath?

  • Global EdTech leader operating across Australia and SE Asia

  • Flexible “Work Anywhere” model (remote, hybrid, or office)

  • High-growth environment with strong career development opportunities

  • Collaborative, innovative, and people-first culture

Please note that this is a full-time, permanent role based in Malaysia. Applicants must have valid working rights in Malaysia.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Design, develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that provide actionable business insights.

  • Analyse marketing, student acquisition, revenue and growth performance to identify trends, risks and opportunities.

  • Build and optimise SQL queries to extract, transform and validate data from multiple sources.

  • Develop data models, measures and visualisations using Power BI, DAX and Power Query.

  • Translate business requirements into effective reporting solutions.

  • Deliver insights and recommendations to support strategic decision-making.

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand reporting needs and drive data-led outcomes.

  • Champion best practice in data visualisation and self-service analytics.

  • Support ongoing improvements to data quality, reporting capabilities and analytics frameworks.

About You

You are a curious and commercially focused analyst who enjoys solving business problems through data and communicating insights that influence action.

You'll bring:

  • Relevant qualifications in Data Analytics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Business or a related discipline.

  • 3+ years' experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence or a similar role.

  • Advanced Power BI skills, including DAX, data modelling and dashboard development.

  • Strong SQL skills and experience working with multiple data sources.

  • Proven ability to translate data into actionable insights and recommendations.

  • Experience developing reporting solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational capabilities.

  • A proactive, self-driven approach and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience within the education sector and exposure to Microsoft Fabric or Azure data environments (Desirable)

What We Offer

At Keypath, we prioritise your wellbeing, growth, and flexibility:

  • Flexible working (remote, hybrid, or office)

  • Medical and dental benefits

  • Employee Assistance Program and wellbeing initiatives

  • Access to LinkedIn Learning and career development programs

  • Inclusive culture with employee-led initiatives and regular team events

  • All equipment provided for your success

Ready to Make an Impact?

Join Keypath and help shape the future of education through data.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive hiring experience.

Apply now and unlock your potential with Keypath.

Director, Demand Generation- Capital One Software (Remote)

Capital One Software Marketing is looking for a Director of Demand Generation to own the pipeline engine that fuels the growth for our industry leading SaaS platform. This is a strategic, revenue-accountable leadership role and not a just lead-generation job. You'll architect and run the integrated demand strategy and you'll be measured on the qualified pipeline, revenue, and efficiency you produce.

You'll partner closely with Sales, RevOps, Product Marketing, SDR/BDR, Partner Marketing, Web Marketing and Data & Analytics teams to build a repeatable, scalable growth engine, developing and delivering always on campaigns and programs for our ICP and target segments.

What you’ll do

Strategy & planning

  • Build and own the end-to-end demand generation strategy by segment, persona, and ICP, mapping campaigns and programs to the full buyer journey from awareness through acquisition.

  • Translate revenue targets into quarterly pipeline and campaign plans, and forecast with credible, data-backed accuracy.

  • Help refine our ideal customer profile, target account lists, and segmentation in partnership with RevOps, Sales, and Product Marketing.

Campaign & program execution

  • Develop and lead integrated, full-funnel campaign and program planning and execution across digital, ABM, nurture, webinars, content syndication, and assist in partner/co-marketing engagements.

  • Stand out in a noisy market with differentiated messaging, creative, and demand generation offers — grounded in buyer insight and competitive positioning.

  • Run a continuous experimentation and testing program to optimize messaging, execution channels, offers, and conversion.

Growth engine & MarTech

  • Build a scalable, privacy-aware demand engine leveraging modern marketing technology.

  • Champion the responsible use of AI to accelerate campaign production, personalization, and analysis.

  • Ensure data quality, attribution discipline, and clean handoffs between marketing and sales.

Sales alignment & pipeline management

  • Refine and govern marketing-to-sales SLAs, lead/account routing, and follow-up cadences.

  • Run joint pipeline inspection and coverage reviews with Sales leadership; prioritize geos, accounts, and segments jointly.

  • Continuously improve conversion rates, velocity, and win rates by stage and segment.

Team & operating cadence

  • Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing team.

  • Lead weekly/monthly/quarterly operating reviews with clear demand metrics, accountability, and course correction.

  • Communicate plans, results, and resource needs to executive leadership with clarity and conviction.

Budget & ROI

  • Own the demand generation budget with disciplined allocation, reallocation, and ROI accountability across channels and segments.

  • Drive down CAC and improve payback period while sustaining pipeline coverage and growth.

Who you are

  • Your curiosity is endless. There’s always something else to learn.

  • You’re flexible and not afraid of change, in fact you welcome the challenge.

  • You share your point of view, but seek out what might be missing and listen.

  • You have big ideas and know the best ones are driven by proof, persistence and patience.

  • You’re a storyteller. You simplify the complex and compel your audience to act.

  • You know how to enjoy yourself. While fun isn’t mandatory, it certainly seems to follow you.

  • You care—about the work, your team and the customers you serve.

Basic Qualifications:

  • At least 10 years years in B2B marketing

  • At least 5 years experience in Software or SaaS demand generation

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated experience of owning pipeline and revenue outcomes in a Software or SaaS business Marketing environment

  • Experience across one or more motions (for example: enterprise, mid-market, and/or product-led growth)

  • Strong understanding of modern marketing technology, CRM (for example: Salesforce), marketing automation (for example: Marketo, HubSpot), attribution and BI, intent and enrichment data, ABM platforms, paid media, and demand analytics

  • Demonstrated experience in leadership, hiring, and coaching skills

  • Demonstrated ability communicating strategy and results to C-suite and board level executives

  • Understanding of funnel metrics, attribution models, cohort analysis, and pipeline economics and the ability to make decisions and trade-offs from data

  • Experience with category creation, international expansion, or channel, partner demand programs

  • Familiarity with community-led growth and developer or technical audiences

  • Experience operationalizing AI in marketing workflows

  • Experience marketing to technical buyers or in a data, cloud, or security category.

  • Privacy-aware measurement expertise (for example: first-party data, consent, modeling)

At this time, Capital One will not sponsor a new applicant for employment authorization for this position.

The minimum and maximum full-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked.

Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

Department Name:

Innovation and highly trained staff. Banner Health leaders can access the staff and resources they need to bring their vision to life. If you’re looking to leverage your abilities – you belong at Banner Health.

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Revenue Cycle Analytics leader to drive data-informed decision making across the system. In this role, you will lead a team responsible for revenue cycle reporting , analytics, and data governance initiatives that support organizational performance, financial health, and future growth. You will partner closely with operational leaders and stakeholders across the system to identify trends, uncover opportunities for improvement, and deliver actionable insights that enhance revenue cycle performance. The ideal candidate is a collaborative leader with strong problem-solving skills who thrives in a complex healthcare environment and is passionate about driving operational excellence through data and innovation.

This can be a remote position if you live in the following states only: AK, AZ, AR, CA, CO, GA, FL, IA, ID, IN, KS, KY, LA, MD, MI, MO, MN, MS, NH, NM, NY, NC, ND, NE, NV, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WI, WV, WA, & WY

Your pay and benefits are important components of your journey at Banner Health. This opportunity includes the option to participate in a variety of health, financial, and security benefits. In addition, this position may be eligible for our Management Incentive Program as part of your Total Rewards package.Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position provides a leadership role for Revenue Cycle analytical support for financial positioning and future growth within the entire Revenue Cycle operational areas. This position leads in the development, analysis, and preparation of strategic Revenue Cycle metrics and reviews current operating results to achieve overall system and entity strategic goals and objectives. This position is responsible for the direction and supervision of the Revenue Cycle Analytics team members.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Compiles Revenue Cycle data, creates enterprise, regional, and local metric dashboard(s) from start to finish (full stack development) and conducts advanced revenue cycle operational performance analysis to provide a high level of financial and operational expertise through analysis and interpretation of data. Gathers and challenges assumptions from various multi-disciplinary teams and data sources.

2. Serves as leader or subject matter expert in Revenue Cycle data, which includes the initiation and assistance in identification and implementation of operating improvements and efficiencies by identifying important trends and variances.

3. Manages data and integrity to include ongoing validation and comparison with Revenue Cycle operational activity. Aligns data communication with key stakeholders to ensure consistent data share and interpretation.

4. Provides direction to manage implementation and support for Revenue Cycle information systems to enhance current and future system functionality.

5. Responsible for Intermediate to Advanced level queries in SQL or similar language AND ability to work with advanced data visualizations AND the ability to conduct advanced revenue cycle operational performance analysis.

6. Acts as the project lead for Revenue Cycle Analytics implementation and systems to enhance current and future system functionality. Manages and maintains the training program, schedule, and deployment to Revenue Cycle Analytics team members.

7. Manages day to day relationship with Revenue Cycle and other operational areas Directors and leaders to manage and maintain standardized metrics and data integrity management across the enterprise.

8. Manages all Revenue Cycle Analytics platforms, systems, interfaces and exchanges.

9. Works on complex problems in which analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. Proven advanced analytical and modeling skills are necessary. Must be able to work with minimal supervision and prioritize multiple projects and use of sophisticated software programs. Exercise judgment within generally defined practices and policies in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Position interacts with all levels of hospital and system leadership and staff, physicians, regulatory agencies, and vendors.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Must possess strong knowledge of business, finance, health management, statistics, engineering and/or analytics as normally obtained through the completion of a bachelor’s degree.

Must possess seven plus years of current and progressive experience of analysis work in healthcare or an equivalent combination of relevant education, technical, business and related industry experience.At least two years of management leadership experience required.

Must be proficient in the use of sophisticated software programs. Proven advanced, analytical and modeling skills are necessary.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Knowledge of statistical analysis is preferred.

MBA preferred.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.

Engineering Director, Architecture & Enablement

AbbVie’s Allergan Aesthetics technology organization is seeking an Engineering Director, Architecture & Enablement to lead a team of highly senior Engineering Solution Architects responsible for shaping and guiding the technical execution of our most complex initiatives.

This is a senior engineering leadership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of architecture, execution, and organizational influence. You will lead a team of staff-level technical leaders who work across engineering teams, systems, and program increments to define solution architecture, surface dependencies early, develop high-level estimates, orchestrate technical alignment, and help ensure successful execution against delivery commitments.

This role is not about owning day-to-day coding teams. It is about leading the technical function that helps those teams succeed on the work that matters most. You and your team will be trusted to bring clarity to complexity, reduce delivery risk, strengthen technical decision-making, and improve confidence in execution across the portfolio.

This is also a rare opportunity to help shape the technology behind one of the most recognized aesthetics portfolios in the world — including products such as BOTOX® and JUVÉDERM® — and the digital platforms that power the leading loyalty experience in the market. The work is meaningful, visible, and directly connected to customer and business outcomes.

The Engineering Director, Architecture & Enablement is a member of the Technology Leadership Team (TLT) for AA Tech and reports directly to the VP Technology, Allergan Aesthetics.

Senior Technical Leadership

You will lead and develop a team of senior, staff-level Engineering Solution Architects who serve as technical leads across major cross-team initiatives. This team plays a central role in helping the organization execute complex work successfully by driving:

  • End-to-end solution architecture across teams and systems
  • Technical dependency mapping and sequencing
  • High-level estimates and level-of-effort alignment
  • Technical orchestration across engineering teams and managers
  • Early identification and resolution of architectural gaps and delivery risks
  • Sustained technical guidance through execution to keep initiatives on track

In addition to leading this team, you will help mature architecture standards, reference patterns, and technical guidelines across the organization. These capabilities matter, but they are secondary to the core mission: enabling strong technical execution and predictable delivery for complex initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of senior Engineering Solution Architects, setting clear expectations and creating a culture of accountability, sound judgment, and high technical impact.
  • Deploy the architecture team to the organization’s highest-priority and most complex initiatives, ensuring the right technical leadership is applied where it matters most.
  • Oversee end-to-end solution architecture for major cross-team efforts, including technical sequencing, dependency planning, and high-level solution design.
  • Guide high-level estimates and level-of-effort assessments in partnership with engineering leaders to improve planning quality and delivery confidence.
  • Drive alignment across engineering teams, managers, and stakeholders on assumptions, tradeoffs, implementation approach, risks, and constraints.
  • Stay engaged through execution to resolve ambiguity, unblock decisions, and ensure solutions are implemented as intended and remain on track against schedule.
  • Serve as a senior technical leader across AA Tech for initiatives that span multiple teams, systems, or domains.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Program Management leaders to strengthen coordination, execution predictability, and technical delivery outcomes.
  • Oversee the development of practical architecture standards, guidelines, and reusable patterns that improve consistency, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Establish lightweight architecture review and alignment mechanisms that support speed and execution without adding unnecessary process.
  • Serve as a member of the AA Tech Technology Leadership Team, contributing to broader technology planning, organizational direction, and leadership decision-making.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or technical leadership roles
  • Significant experience leading complex technical initiatives across multiple teams, systems, and stakeholders
  • Experience managing highly senior technical individual contributors, including Staff-level engineers or architects
  • Strong background in solution design, dependency management, technical estimation, and cross-team technical leadership
  • Proven ability to influence engineering managers, technical leaders, and teams without relying on direct delivery ownership
  • Strong understanding of modern software architecture, distributed systems, APIs, integrations, and engineering delivery practices
  • Experience designing and guiding high-reliability, cloud-based implementations with strong focus on scalability, resilience, performance, and operational excellence
  • Experience with AI-driven engineering implementation, including use of tools such as Claude Code or similar AI-assisted development capabilities to improve engineering workflows and delivery outcomes
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading a formal solution architecture function within a technology organization
  • Experience supporting execution across major roadmaps, large initiatives, or program increments
  • Experience working in complex, matrixed environments with multiple engineering teams and business stakeholders
  • Experience developing architecture standards, technical guidelines, and reusable engineering patterns
  • Experience in regulated environments where quality, traceability, and auditability are important
  • Experience with our core technology stack, including AWS, React, TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Snowflake

raw.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

People at Vectara are passionate about helping users take advantage of breakthroughs in applied AI to discover and learn more about their business and the world around them. Our team is a group of unquestionable all-stars in their respective fields of computer science and business.

Our work is validated by some of the most demanding technology, financial services, and semiconductor companies in the world.

  • Broadcom has standardized on Vectara as the central platform for Agentic RAG and Conversational AI. Combining Agentic RAG and Search together powers their customer facing support serving 3M users.
  • Texas Instruments uses Vectara for air-gapped on-prem search that accelerates design-in decisions.
  • Compass Real Estate replaced a five-person engineering effort with a single AI expert building on Vectara.
  • Aon enables non-technical analysts to query complex claims data in natural language.

The business outcomes are concrete. Customers consistently describe Vectara as the moment their AI strategy went from experimentation to production.

Joining Vectara means joining a growing, well-funded company at the exact inflection point when enterprise AI is moving from pilots to scale. You will work alongside a team that has built some of the most influential search, retrieval, and machine-learning systems in the industry. The problem space is large, the market is early, and the impact of every hire is visible.

We are looking for the few people who have the grit to join a Series A startup that is growing rapidly in a quickly evolving market. You are someone who doesn't back down from a challenge and will do what it takes to make it successful. You want to be part of a team that puts in the hours with pipeline generation, finding deals by networking and creativity, and 100% hustling. You are effectively the owner of your business in the region and a founding Enterprise Account Executive. If this fits you, continue reading.

Own the full sales cycle from first outreach to signed contract. You find, develop, and close your own opportunities. Inbound marketing is in place but consider that extra.

  • Sell into complex enterprise accounts where the buyer is technical (VP of Engineering, CIO, CDO, Head of AI/ML) and the problem is real — data sprawl, compliance risk, AI accuracy, knowledge retrieval at scale.
  • Navigate multi-stakeholder deals across IT, security, legal, and the business line. Build champions, map the org, and drive consensus.
  • Develop deep expertise in Vectara’s platform so you can answer hard technical questions, and earn the trust of engineering-led buyers.
  • Partner closely with our engineering team — we have a very large engineering org relative to sales, and they’re your secret weapon. Bring them into deals early and often.
  • Build your territory from scratch. Create your own target lists, develop your own outbound sequences, and generate pipeline through hustle, creativity, and relentless follow-up.
  • Give direct feedback to the product team. At this stage, what you hear from the market shapes what we build next.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3–8 years of enterprise or mid-market B2B SaaS sales experience, ideally selling technical products to technical buyers.
  • Proven track record of exceeding quota in environments with limited brand recognition or sales infrastructure.
  • Experience selling into at least one of: AI/ML, data infrastructure, cloud platforms, cybersecurity, or enterprise software.
  • Comfortable engaging with C-suite, VP, and Director-level stakeholders across both technical and business functions.
  • Strong written and verbal communication — you can write a compelling cold email and deliver a boardroom presentation with equal confidence.
  • Based in or willing to travel to key markets. We’re building a distributed team, but face-to-face matters.
  • You don't need a perfect LinkedIn profile. Your story matters most.

Your customer relationships and their trust matters more than the length of your experience.

Perks and Benefits:

100% paid Medical, Dental, Vision for employees. Option of Health Savings Account (HSA) or Flexible Savings Account (FSA). Generous paid time off (PTO) plus paid sick time and holidays. Professional development and training opportunities. Company virtual happy hours and fun team building activities and more.

Salary is just one component of Vectara’s employee compensation. Our full-time employees are also equity owners in the company, which although not an immediate cash component, can have positive impacts on long-term total compensation for each participating employee. We would be remiss if we didn’t highlight and celebrate our focus on engaging many of our employees in being economic co-owners of the business.

Vectara welcomes all. We value the collective wisdom of people from different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. We never discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. Vectara has a positive and supportive culture—we look for people who are inventive and work to be a little better every single day. We seek to be smart, humble, hardworking and, above all, curious. After all, we are on a mission to find meaning.

MLOps Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: MLOps Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a MLOps Engineer Engineer to design, build, and operate high-performance, highly reliable inference platforms for serving large machine learning models in production. The role focuses on the systems engineering side of AI deployment, including request routing, batching, caching, autoscaling, GPU utilization, and end-to-end observability across diverse model workloads. The ideal candidate brings strong distributed systems and performance engineering expertise, has shipped serving systems at scale, and understands the trade-offs between latency, throughput, cost, and quality in ML serving.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and operate model serving platforms supporting diverse workloads including LLMs, vision models, and recommendation systems.
  • Optimize inference performance using continuous batching, paged attention, speculative decoding, and request multiplexing.
  • Implement multi-tenant routing, rate limiting, and quality-of-service policies across model endpoints.
  • Build autoscaling and capacity management systems that balance latency, throughput, and cost.
  • Tune GPU utilization, memory management, and KV cache strategies for LLM serving workloads.
  • Integrate model serving with API gateways, identity systems, and observability platforms.
  • Implement caching, prompt deduplication, and response reuse strategies where appropriate.
  • Drive end-to-end observability including latency histograms, queue dynamics, GPU utilization, and error tracking.
  • Develop deployment workflows including canary releases, shadow testing, and automated rollback.
  • Operate incident response for high-availability AI services and drive durable reliability improvements.
  • Collaborate with ML and product teams to support new model releases and capability rollouts.
  • Implement security controls including request signing, content filtering, and abuse detection at the serving layer.
  • Document operational procedures, performance characteristics, and tuning guidance for internal teams.
  • Stay current with AI serving research and translate advances into production capabilities.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Six or more years of experience in distributed systems, infrastructure, or ML platform engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and a systems language such as Go, Rust, or C++.
  • Deep experience operating high-throughput, low-latency services in production.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM or large model inference frameworks such as vLLM or TensorRT-LLM.
  • Strong understanding of GPU architecture, memory hierarchies, and accelerator utilization.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, autoscaling, and modern cloud platforms.
  • Experience with observability stacks including metrics, tracing, and structured logging.
  • Solid grounding in performance engineering and capacity planning.
  • Strong communication and incident response skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Open-source contributions to model serving infrastructure.
  • Experience with multi-region or globally distributed AI serving.
  • Familiarity with model quantization, distillation, and compression techniques.
  • Exposure to FinOps for AI workloads and cost-efficient serving design.
  • Experience supporting external-facing AI APIs at scale.
How to Apply

Jeeves is looking for an exceptional Technical Recruiter to join our Global People Team and own hiring for our Engineering, Product, and Data organizations. You'll partner directly with engineering leaders to build pipelines for backend, infrastructure, mobile, data, and product roles across our global teams — and you'll shape how we scale technical hiring as the company grows. This role reports to the Head of Global Talent Acquisition.

Our ideal candidate has recruited technical talent at a fintech or software company and has start-up experience. You should be comfortable reading a system design job description, holding your own in a conversation with a staff engineer, and building sourcing strategies that go well beyond LinkedIn Recruiter. You'll run full-cycle: deep sourcing, technical screening, market mapping, candidate experience, and closing.

Location: This is a full-time remote position.

Responsibilities:

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for technical roles — engineering, product, and data — from intake through offer acceptance.
  • Run structured intake meetings with engineering hiring managers: translate technical requirements into a search strategy, calibration criteria, and a realistic market view.
  • Build and execute sourcing strategies for hard-to-find technical talent using Boolean and X-ray search, GitHub, Stack Overflow, open-source communities, technical Slack/Discord groups, conference and meetup lists, and AI-assisted sourcing tools.
  • Conduct technical pre-screens that go beyond a resume walk — assess depth, scope of ownership, and technical decision-making well enough to give hiring managers a real signal.
  • Deliver talent market intelligence: competitive mapping, compensation benchmarks, and honest feedback when a req's requirements don't match the market.
  • Manage the candidate experience end to end — timely communication, thoughtful prep, and a process technical candidates actually respect.
  • Negotiate and close offers for competitive technical candidates, often against other fintech and Big Tech offers.
  • Advocate for a data-driven approach: track funnel conversion, source effectiveness, time-to-fill, and pass-through rates, and use them to improve the process.
  • Partner with engineering leadership on interview panel design, scorecards, and interviewer training to keep our bar consistent and our process fair.
  • Drive technical employer branding — job posting optimization, engineering-focused content, social campaigns, and community presence.
  • Own the end-to-end logistics of the process, from posting reqs to scheduling to offer letters to a seamless onboarding handoff.
  • Contribute to broader Global People Operations projects and initiatives.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of recruiting experience, with at least 3 years focused on technical roles (engineering, product, or data).
  • Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.
  • LatAm technical recruiting experience required, including Mexico, Colombia, and/or Brazil. Global recruiting experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated technical fluency: you can distinguish between backend stacks, understand what a platform vs. product engineer does, and speak credibly about the work without a script.
  • Proven track record of closing senior and specialized technical hires in a high-growth environment.
  • Advanced sourcing skills across multiple channels — Boolean/X-ray, GitHub and other technical communities, referrals, competitive intelligence, and outbound campaigns with strong response rates.
  • Experience recruiting in both a startup environment and a mid-to-large stable organization preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with an ATS and modern sourcing stack — Lever, LinkedIn Recruiter, and tools like Gem, SeekOut, or HireEZ. Lever specifically is a plus.
  • Comfort working with recruiting data and reporting; able to build and defend a pipeline forecast.
  • Strong consultative skills with local and remote engineering hiring managers — taking requirements, pushing back when needed, and keeping pipelines visible.
  • Able to work independently with limited supervision and prioritize across multiple competing reqs.
  • Agile and able to pivot quickly as priorities shift.
  • Collaborative and team oriented, with genuine passion for candidate experience.
