Job Description:

Note: Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.

Do you thrive on helping clients solve complex business challenges? Do you bring deep expertise in the Defined Contribution retirement industry and enjoy partnering with clients to develop innovative solutions? As a member of our Data Consulting team, you will play a critical role in delivering high-quality, comprehensive, and cost-effective solutions that help clients optimize and customize their benefit programs.

The Role

As a Senior Data Consultant, you will be responsible for driving business development efforts and overseeing the successful delivery of data consulting services for clients. You will serve as a trusted advisor, collaborating directly with clients, consultants, and internal Fidelity associates to understand business requirements, identify data and administration needs, and develop customized solutions.

In this role, you will lead client engagements from strategy through execution, ensuring projects are managed effectively, delivered on time, and aligned with client objectives. Success requires strong leadership, program management expertise, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

  • Build, manage, and expand client relationships by consistently delivering exceptional service and measurable value.

  • Lead the development and presentation of strategic, value-added proposals that address client needs and drive business growth.

  • Guide project teams in developing realistic plans, including scope, timelines, resource requirements, and deliverables.

  • Provide program oversight to ensure initiatives remain aligned with agreed-upon strategy, budget, and objectives.

  • Proactively identify risks and challenges, developing practical solutions to keep projects on track.

  • Gather, analyze, and apply client-specific benefit plan knowledge, including administrative processes, system configurations, data structures, and operational requirements.

  • Partner across client and internal teams to deliver innovative, scalable solutions that improve outcomes and enhance the client experience.

The Expertise We're Looking For

  • 12 plus years of experience in Defined Contribution consulting, client management, or benefits administration leadership within a corporate benefits organization, outsourcing provider, or consulting firm.

  • 3 plus years of business development experience, including identifying opportunities, developing proposals, and closing new business.

  • 4 plus years of program or project management experience in a client-facing environment.

  • Strong knowledge of Defined Contribution plans and recordkeeping administration is required.

  • Experience with Defined Benefit plans, Stock Plans, Health Savings Accounts (HSAs), Health and Welfare administration, payroll systems, or HRIS platforms is a plus.

  • Proven ability to lead the full business development lifecycle, from prospecting and solution design through contract execution.

  • Exceptional relationship management skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate, and build trust with clients and partners.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and strategic thinking capabilities.

  • Demonstrated expertise in program and project management, including managing multiple priorities and stakeholders.

  • Deep knowledge of the Defined Contribution marketplace, industry trends, and operational practices.

The Team

The Fidelity Workplace Consulting Group is composed of over 600 professionals who advise clients on the management of their domestic benefits. This is a fast-growing business within Fidelity, providing a broad variety of services that touch on every area of benefits design, strategy, funding, communication, and delivery! While we focus on working with the Fortune 1000, we also work with Fidelity clients of all sizes.

In this role, you'll combine industry expertise, consultative leadership, and data-driven problem solving to help clients navigate complex benefits administration challenges while strengthening long-term relationships and driving business growth.

Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model

Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.

The base salary range for this position is $110,000-$222,000 per year.

Placement in the range will vary based on job responsibilities and scope, geographic location, candidate’s relevant experience, and other factors.

Base salary is only part of the total compensation package. Depending on the position and eligibility requirements, the offer package may also include bonus or other variable compensation.

We offer a wide range of benefits to meet your evolving needs and help you live your best life at work and at home. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage and emotional well-being support, market-leading retirement, generous paid time off and parental leave, charitable giving employee match program, and educational assistance including student loan repayment, tuition reimbursement, and learning resources to develop your career. Note, the application window closes when the position is filled or unposted.

Please be advised that Fidelity’s business is governed by the provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, the Investment Company Act of 1940, ERISA, numerous state laws governing securities, investment and retirement-related financial activities and the rules and regulations of numerous self-regulatory organizations, including FINRA, among others. raw.title: Special Projects Manager (Communications Team)
raw.excerpt: The Future of Life Institute (FLI) is hiring a Special Projects Manager for the Communications Team.
raw.description:
The Future of Life Institute (FLI) is hiring a Special Projects Manager for the Communications Team. The Communications Team produces a high volume of design and digital work — websites, campaign microsites, event identities, reports and assets — for a global audience, often on fast timelines tied to policy moments. We work with a retained external studio that delivers design and development from briefs, supported by a small in-house team. You will be the person who makes that model work - driving diverse projects from initial scoping all the way to completion.
The Special Projects Manager will report directly to the Director of Communications.

Who we are

FLI educates and engages lawmakers, key stakeholders, and the general public about transformative technologies and their implications. We advocate for policies and approaches that mitigate catastrophic risks while advancing positive futures for humanity.

As Special Projects Manager, you will:

    • Develop briefs: translate stakeholder requirements into clear, actionable creative and technical briefs, and push back constructively when asks are unclear, conflicting or unscoped.

    • Oversee project performance and progress: work with internal and external stakeholders to define what success looks like for each project, integrate those goals into design and content strategies, and develop/execute comms projects that reflect them.

    • Identify, onboard and manage agencies and contractors: identify the skill gaps required to make a project shine, then source and steer talent to fill those gaps through web development agencies or individual freelancers.

    • Own quality assurance: define what "done" looks like — reviewing deliverables against brief, brand guidelines and accessibility standards (WCAG), running structured review rounds, and holding the final quality bar before anything ships.

    • Product innovation: ideate and develop digital products to help achieve FLI’s mission and meet org objectives.

    • Run special projects: deliver multi-month initiatives such as international creative contests end to end.

    • Steward brand coherence: work with the website development agency to maintain our design system and keep high-volume output visually consistent.

Required experience and qualifications:

    • Based in a timezone between West Coast, USA and the UK (UTC-8 to UTC+1).

    • Proven ability to coordinate complex, multi-stakeholder projects — comfortable navigating competing priorities, securing alignment from senior colleagues, and turning messy input into clear direction.

    • A track record of building or significantly improving delivery processes — intake, review, QA or approval workflows — not just operating within them.

    • Project management experience across design, communications and/or digital/web projects, ideally including managing external agencies.

Required skills and qualities:

    • Genuine interest in FLI's mission and the issues we work on — able to represent our work credibly to agencies, judges, contest entrants and partners.

    • Sharp quality instincts and the confidence to send things back when they're not right (ideally provable with a portfolio of shipped work you've quality-assured).

    • Calm under deadline pressure; comfortable saying no and offering alternatives.

Preferred qualifications, skills and qualities:

    • Experience running participatory or multi-stakeholder projects — contests, awards, grant rounds, festivals or similar.

    • Familiarity with website delivery: CMS platforms and enough technical literacy to triage issues and talk credibly with developers.

    • Working knowledge of SEO and digital audience growth: technical and on-page fundamentals, analytics tools (e.g. GA4, Search Console), and how content and campaign decisions affect reach.

    • Nonprofit, policy, advocacy or campaign experience.

Application Deadline: 2nd October 2026

Start Date: We'd like the chosen candidate to start as soon as possible after accepting an offer.

Application Process: Apply by uploading your resume, a portfolio of design products you have quality assured (if available), alongside a short answer to the following question(s):

  • In 200 words or less, please describe the digital or communications project you are most proud of working on. What was the project and how were your contributions critical to its success.

  • In 200 words or less, outline why are you interested in working at FLI in particular

Please apply via our website. Email applications are not accepted.

FLI aims to be an inclusive organization. We proactively seek job applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds. If you are passionate about FLI’s mission and think you have what it takes to be successful in this role even though you may not check all the boxes, please still apply. We would appreciate the opportunity to consider your application.

Questions may be directed to .

About the Future of Life Institute

Founded in 2014, FLI is an independent non-profit working to steer transformative technology towards benefiting life and away from extreme large-scale risks. Our work includes grantmaking, educational outreach, and policy engagement.

Our work has been featured widely, including in The Washington Post, Politico, Vox, Forbes, The Guardian, the BBC, The Economist and Wired.

Some of our achievements include:

  • Superintelligence Statement, an open letter calling for a prohibition on the development of superintelligent AI until there is strong public buy-in and scientific consensus that it can be developed safely and controllably. The letter has been signed by more than 130,000 people, including Yoshua Bengio, Geoffrey Hinton, Steve Wozniak, Richard Branson, Steve Bannon, Prince Harry and Susan Rice.
  • Superintelligence Imagined Creative Contest - From 180+ submissions, we selected 6 winning artworks that best illustrate the risks of advanced artificial intelligence.
  • The Asilomar AI Principles, one of the earliest and most influential sets of AI governance principles.
  • The Pro-Human AI Declaration, a document with five guidelines on how AI development must be centred on humanity first, created during a meeting of bipartisan civil society groups spanning faith, labour, and think tanks.
  • How would a nuclear war between Russia and the US affect you personally?- A scientifically accurate simulation showing the consequences of nuclear war, with over 6 millions views and a feature in Time Magazine.
FLI is a largely virtual organization, with a team of approximately 40 distributed internationally, mostly in Europe and the US. We have four offices: Campbell in California, Brussels in Belgium, London in the UK, and Washington DC. We meet in person as a full team twice a year.

This role works closely with the People, Finance, and Legal teams plus external partners to deliver competitive, compliant, and employee-centric benefits programs that support our global workforce.

While experience managing global benefits is valuable, we also welcome candidates with deep domestic benefits expertise who are excited to broaden their scope and build experience supporting employees around the world.

  • Retirement and pension programs

  • Life and disability insurance

Analytics & Reporting

Preferred:

Experience in biotechnology, healthcare, life sciences, or high-growth technology environments.

AI & Digital Fluency

  • Demonstrate curiosity, sound judgment, and the ability to critically evaluate and responsibly leverage AI-enabled tools in accordance with company policies, ethical standards, and regulatory requirements to improve the efficiency, effectiveness, and quality of work.

Hybrid Work Model:This section is applicable to onsite employees who are eligible for hybrid work location as specified by management and related policies. Guardant has defined days for in-person/onsite collaboration and work-from-home days for individual-focused time. All U.S. employees who live within 50 miles of a Guardant facility will be required to be onsite on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays. Description

Job Title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)

Employment Type: Full-time

Reports To: Executive Management / CEO

We are seeking a proactive, self-directed Sales Development Representative (SDR) to drive top-of-funnel sales activities while offering key administrative support to leadership. In this role, you will work closely with the CEO and Marketing Team to execute targeted outreach strategies, discover prospect IT environments, and secure qualified First Time Appointments (FTAs).

This position requires a balance of high-volume sales outreach, marketing collaboration, and administrative project management, offering significant autonomy and latitude in daily decision-making.

Execute high-volume outbound calling campaigns (up to 200 calls per day) to target business prospects.

Professionally navigate gatekeepers to establish contact and gather critical intel regarding prospects' current IT infrastructure and business needs.

Manage a structured 3-call follow-up cadence post-mailer delivery to re-engage leads and secure First Time Appointments (FTAs) for sales leadership.

2. Marketing Collaboration & Strategy

Collaborate closely with the CEO and Marketing Team to refine prospect lists, offer feedback on lead engagement, and support role-aligned marketing initiatives.

Coordinate the deployment of targeted direct mailers based on initial discovery calls and prospect intelligence.

3. Administrative & Operational Support

Provide flexible administrative assistance to executive management and cross-functional teams.

Prioritize, organize, and execute multiple administrative and operational projects simultaneously.

Exercise sound judgment and independent discretion in managing daily schedules and task completion.

Experience: Prior experience in outbound sales, cold calling, telemarketing, or administrative support (experience in IT, MSP, or technology services is a strong plus).

raw.description:
Picture this—an Account Executive closes the biggest deal in Expel history, helping the company make its annual number, and you structured the deal that made it happen. Sound exciting? Then keep reading.

Deal Desk is where Sales, Legal, and Finance either work as one team or grind against each other. Our next Senior Deal Desk Manager is the person who makes it the former: pricing and structuring deals with reps, pressure-testing terms with Legal, protecting revenue recognition and margin with Finance, and getting all three to a fast, defensible "yes."

At Expel, we believe if we take care of our employees, they'll look after our customers, and the rest works itself out. It's as simple as that. We've built a place to work based on transparency, where people love what they do and their work gets appreciated.

If you want to join a team that finds a way to say "yes" and strives to be excellent, we'd like to hear from you.

What Expel can do for you

  • Give you real ownership of the quoting, approval, and contracting process—and the room to fix what's broken
  • Put you at the table with Sales, Legal, and Finance leadership on the deals that matter most
  • Offer an environment that values your work, ideas, and creativity
  • Provide the tools, technology, and cross-functional support you need to run an effective Deal Desk
  • Give you a front-row seat to how a growing cybersecurity company actually sells

What you can do for Expel

With Sales

  • Be the go-to for the field on quoting, pricing scenarios, discount structures, and non-standard terms
  • Coach reps and managers on structuring opportunities early, so complexity surfaces before the last week of the quarter
  • Run approvals end to end—build the deal package, drive it through the chain, and bring the decision and the reasoning back to the rep

With Legal

  • Act as the business-side counterpart on contract negotiations—translate commercial intent into terms Legal can paper, and legal risk into trade-offs Sales can act on
  • Maintain the fallback and playbook library for commonly negotiated terms so standard redlines don't need escalation

With Finance

  • Make sure every closed deal holds up: revenue recognition, ARR classification, billing terms, margin thresholds, and approval documentation
  • Support quarterly close and audit with clean deal records and a defensible approval trail
  • Give Finance forward visibility into late-stage pipeline, discount trends, and deal structures that move the forecast

Across the board

  • Own and improve the quoting, approval, and contracting stages of our lead-to-cash process
  • Work with Revenue Operations and Business Systems on Salesforce and CPQ configuration, approval workflows, and reporting
  • Use data to understand what's working, what's not, and what to do next

What you should bring with you

  • 5–8 years of experience, including 3+ years in Deal Desk, sales operations, or revenue operations at a technology company—SaaS strongly preferred
  • Experience supporting an enterprise or mid-market SaaS sales team through complex, negotiated deals
  • Working knowledge of SaaS revenue fundamentals: revenue recognition, ARR definitions, contract structures, and standard commercial terms
  • Hands-on skill with Salesforce and Salesforce CPQ, including approvals and quote configuration, plus strong Excel and Google Sheets chops
  • The judgment to know when to solve, when to escalate, and how to tell a rep no without losing their trust
  • Strong active listening and conflict management skills—you build consensus across stakeholders with competing incentives
  • Cybersecurity or managed security experience is a plus, not a requirement

Additional notes

Applicants must reside within the continental United States, and can work remotely or from our Expel HQ office in Herndon, VA. Occasional travel will be required.

The base salary range for this role is between $115,000 USD and $160,000 USD + variable eligibility and equity. While the full salary band reflects our long-term compensation framework, we're primarily targeting candidates between $129,000 and $149,000 based on experience, skills, and market data.

We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your salary will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You'll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We're only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We'll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

raw.description:
We're looking for an E-Commerce Copywriter who understands that great product copy is about more than describing what a product does. You understand the relationship between products, customers, messaging, SEO, and conversion—and you know how to turn product features into compelling reasons to buy.

The Role

As our E-Commerce Copywriter, you'll help shape how Zulay Kitchen's products are presented across our e-commerce channels. You'll write and optimize product listings, develop messaging for new products, research customers and competitors, and continuously look for ways to make our copy more compelling and conversion-focused.

We're looking for someone who is a strong writer, customer-focused, creative, curious, and obsessed with figuring out what makes people click—and buy.

What You'll Do

E-Commerce Copywriting

  • Write and optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, and other e-commerce content.
  • Create compelling product copy that clearly communicates what the product does, why it matters, and why customers should choose it.
  • Turn product features into customer-focused benefits and persuasive messaging.
  • Develop copy for Amazon listings, Shopify product pages, A+ Content, social media, email campaigns, product packaging, and other customer-facing marketing materials.
  • Write messaging for new product launches, promotions, and other marketing initiatives.
  • Maintain a consistent and recognizable Zulay Kitchen brand voice across product content.

Conversion & Product Messaging

  • Review existing product listings and identify opportunities to improve clarity, engagement, and conversion.
  • Analyze customer reviews, questions, feedback, and competitor listings to understand what customers care about.
  • Identify customer pain points, objections, motivations, and purchasing triggers.
  • Develop messaging that addresses customer concerns and makes the value of our products immediately clear.
  • Help identify the strongest selling points and differentiators for each product.
  • Continuously test and refine messaging based on performance and customer response.

SEO & Marketplace Optimization

  • Conduct keyword research and incorporate relevant search terms naturally into product copy.
  • Optimize listings for search visibility without sacrificing readability or persuasive messaging.
  • Stay current on Amazon and e-commerce SEO best practices.
  • Research competitors and identify opportunities to differentiate Zulay Kitchen products.
  • Keep up with changes in marketplace algorithms, customer behavior, and e-commerce trends.

Research & Collaboration

  • Work closely with the Director of Marketing to develop and execute product messaging and content strategies.
  • Collaborate with Category Managers, Amazon Sales Specialists, Designers, and other team members to understand products and their target customers.
  • Conduct product and market research before developing copy.
  • Partner with the creative team to make sure copy and visuals work together to tell a strong product story.
  • Take feedback, iterate quickly, and continuously improve your work.

You'd Be a Great Fit If...

You don't just look at a product and ask "What does it do?"

You ask:

"Why would someone want this?"

"What problem is this solving?"

"What would make a customer choose this over the competition?"
"What might stop someone from buying?"
"How can we communicate the value in a way that makes people want to click 'Add to Cart'?"

You're able to take a product with a list of features and turn it into copy that makes the customer understand why they need it.

You're equally comfortable researching competitors and customer reviews, analyzing an existing product listing, and sitting down to write a strong headline or product description.

You don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to be improved. You're constantly looking for opportunities to make our listings clearer, more compelling, and more likely to convert.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional copywriting experience, preferably in e-commerce, DTC, retail, or consumer products.
  • Proven experience writing product listings or conversion-focused copy.
  • Excellent written English, grammar, and editing skills.
  • Strong understanding of customer psychology and persuasive writing.
  • Experience with Amazon and other e-commerce marketplaces is highly preferred.
  • Understanding of e-commerce SEO and keyword optimization.
  • Strong research skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple products and deadlines independently.
  • Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating on copy.
  • A strong instinct for what makes copy clear, engaging, and convincing.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with Amazon A+ Content / Enhanced Brand Content.
  • Familiarity with Helium 10, Jungle Scout, or similar tools.
  • Shopify experience.
  • Experience working with physical consumer products, particularly kitchen, home, or lifestyle brands.
  • Experience collaborating with designers, photographers, or creative teams.
  • Experience using AI tools to support research and content workflows while maintaining originality and brand voice.

raw.excerpt: We’re seeking a highly skilled, execution-focused Senior Backend Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of experience to join our team.
raw.description:
We’re seeking a highly skilled, execution-focused Senior Backend Engineer with a minimum of 5 years of experience to join our team. This role demands hands-on expertise in building and scaling distributed systems, strong proficiency in Java, and deep knowledge of cloud-native infrastructure. You will be expected to design robust backend services, optimize performance across storage and caching layers, and enable seamless integrations using modern messaging and CI/CD pipelines.

You’ll be working in a high-scale, high-impact environment where reliability, speed, and efficiency are paramount. If you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and have a passion for distributed systems, this is the right role for you.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain distributed backend systems at scale.
  • Write high-performance, production-grade code in Java.
  • Architect and optimize storage systems, ensuring efficient query performance and scalable data models.
  • Implement caching strategies to reduce latency and improve system throughput.
  • Build and manage services leveraging AWS cloud infrastructure.
  • Develop resilient messaging pipelines using Kafka (or equivalent) for real-time data processing.
  • Define and streamline CI/CD pipelines, ensuring rapid and reliable deployment cycles.
  • Collaborate with product managers, frontend engineers, and DevOps to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Monitor system performance, identify bottlenecks, and apply proactive fixes.
  • Drive best practices in software engineering, testing, and code reviews.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in backend engineering, with deep hands-on coding experience.
  • Strong proficiency in Java and familiarity with modern frameworks.
  • Proven track record in building scalable distributed systems.
  • Hands-on expertise with AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, RDS).
  • Solid understanding of messaging systems like Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar.
  • Strong grasp of query performance optimization and storage system design.
  • Experience with caching solutions (Redis, Memcached, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, etc.).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with a proactive mindset.

Benefits

  • Best in class salary: We hire only the best, and we pay accordingly.
  • Proximity Talks: Meet other designers, engineers, and product geeks — and learn from experts in the field.
  • Keep on learning with a world-class team: Work with the best in the field, challenge yourself constantly, and learn something new every day.

About us—

Proximity is the trusted technology, design, and consulting partner for some of the biggest Sports, Media, and Entertainment companies in the world. We’re headquartered in San Francisco and have offices in Palo Alto, Dubai, Mumbai, and Bangalore.

Since 2019, Proximity has built high-impact, scalable products used by millions of users every day. Today, we are a global team of engineers, designers, product managers, and experts solving complex problems and building cutting-edge technology at scale.

raw.excerpt: Why is Health Advocate a great place to work?  For starters, Health Advocate employees enjoy helping people every single day.
raw.description:
Why is Health Advocate a great place to work? For starters, Health Advocate employees enjoy helping people every single day. Employees are given the training they need to do their jobs well, and they work with supervisors and staff who are supportive and friendly. Employees have room to grow, and many of Health Advocate's supervisors are promoted from within the company. Join our award winning team!

2025:

  • Stevie® Awards for Sales & Customer Service: Customer Service Department of the Year – Healthcare, Pharmaceuticals, and Related Industries, Bronze Winner

2024:

  • Excellence in Customer Service Awards: Organization of the Year (Small)

  • Stevie® Awards for Sales & Customer Service: Customer Service Department of the Year – Healthcare, Pharmaceuticals, and Related Industries, Bronze Winner

  • Best in Biz Awards: Most Customer-Friendly Company of the Year – Medium and large category (Silver)

As part of Teleperformance in the US, we were also named #95 in the 2024 ‘Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For®’ in the USA by Great Places to Work (GPTW®)

**EVENING SHIFTS**

Your Mission: What Success Looks Like

Your primary accountability and Personal Health Advocate, Registered Nurse is to deliver high-quality, member-centered clinical advocacy while meeting service, quality, and case management standards.

Success in this role includes consistently achieving:

🔹 Member Advocacy & Clinical Guidance

  • Receive inbound member calls related to a wide range of healthcare issues (e.g., infertility, chronic disease, medications, diagnoses)

  • Assess needs and determine the best course of action while adhering to established policies, procedures, and performance indicators (KPIs)

  • Take ownership of member cases by going beyond the initial request and encouraging continued engagement

🔹 Education, Trust & Relationship-Building

  • Educate members on their medical conditions, diagnostic testing, test results, and available treatment options

  • Explain complex medical and benefit-related information clearly and compassionately

  • Build trusted relationships that empower members to actively participate in their healthcare decisions

🔹 Care Coordination & System Navigation

  • Provide members with options for healthcare providers and services based on clinical needs, geographic location, and benefit coverage

  • Research providers through credentialing, education verification, and affiliations with recognized medical centers

  • Facilitate communication between members, treating physicians, and insurance carriers

  • Assist with scheduling and re-scheduling appointments, transferring medical records, resolving access issues, and clarifying benefit provisions

  • Intercede on behalf of members to obtain earlier appointments or remove barriers to care

  • Support members with prescriptions, pre-service fee negotiations, and authorization-related challenges

🔹 Case Management, Documentation & Follow-Up

  • Maintain accurate, timely documentation using approved case management systems and procedures

  • Place outbound follow-up calls when issues cannot be resolved during the initial interaction

  • Respond to delegate box, answer service, and after-hours calls as required

  • Escalate cases appropriately and on a timely basis to supervisors or internal clinical resources

🔹 Professional Growth & Team Contribution

  • Stay current on patient care procedures, diagnoses, authorizations, denials, and evolving healthcare practices

  • Mentor and support new team members as needed

  • Collaborate with colleagues to maintain service excellence and balanced workflows

Who You Are: The Leader We’re Looking For

You are an experienced nurse who brings clinical judgment, composure, and accountability to every interaction.

You naturally demonstrate:

  • Ownership and follow-through
    You take responsibility for member outcomes and see cases through with care and precision.

  • Empathy grounded in professionalism
    You listen deeply and respond with compassion while maintaining clarity, confidence, and appropriate boundaries.

  • Strong critical thinking
    You quickly synthesize clinical information, prioritize what matters, and determine effective next steps.

  • Clear and confident communication
    You explain complex medical and insurance concepts in a way members can understand and trust.

  • A commitment to quality and results
    You are motivated by accuracy, meaningful resolution, and delivering an exceptional member experience.

  • Curiosity and continuous learning
    You stay current on healthcare trends, systems, and procedures to provide thoughtful, informed guidance.

Who Will Thrive in This Role

You will thrive in this role if you are comfortable balancing compassionate member conversations with a fast-paced, high-volume phone environment. This is a strong fit for someone who can stay organized, document thoroughly and in real time, follow cases through to resolution, and maintain a calm, professional presence while managing multiple member needs throughout the day.

Minimum Qualifications

Education

  • BSN or RN degree from an accredited college or university (required)

Licensure

  • Active and unrestricted State or Multi-State Registered Nurse license (required)

Experience

  • Minimum 3–5 years of clinical and/or medical management experience

Behavioral and/or mental health experience is strongly preferred, especially experience supporting members through sensitive, complex, or emotionally charged healthcare situations.

Core Skills

  • Strong understanding of medical terminology and healthcare systems

  • Excellent verbal communication skills and professional phone presence

  • Ability to explain complex healthcare topics to diverse populations

  • Highly effective listening, problem-solving, and issue-resolution skills

  • Strong organizational and administrative abilities

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word and Excel

  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, remote team environment

Team Interface & Customer Service

  • Establish and maintain professional relationships with internal and external customers

  • Collaborate with team members to meet departmental goals

  • Deliver customer service that consistently exceeds expectations

  • Treat all individuals with dignity, respect, and professionalism

  • Escalate workflow or communication issues to leadership as appropriate

PLEASE NOTE: This role offers $37 per hour and is for evening hours:

12-8:30 pm EST.

12:30-9 pm EST.

1-9:30 pm EST.

Mental and Physical Requirements

This position is fully remote and requires a dedicated, HIPAA-compliant workspace with reliable internet access.

The nature of the work is sedentary, involving prolonged sitting and continuous computer and phone use. Essential functions include repetitive motion, typing, concentration, reading, and ongoing verbal and written communication throughout the workday.

Related Duties as Assigned

This job description describes the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all activities, duties, or responsibilities.

Job incumbents may be asked to perform other duties as required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions outlined above.

Please contact your local Employee Relations representative to request a review of accommodations.

Why Health Advocate?

Because here, nursing expertise drives impact.

You’ll join an organization that values structure, autonomy, accountability, and compassion — where your clinical judgment directly improves the lives of the members you serve.

Company Overview

Health Advocate is the nation’s leading provider of health advocacy, navigation, well-being and integrated benefits programs. For 20 years, Health Advocate has provided expert support to help our members navigate the complexities of healthcare and achieve the best possible health and well-being. Our solutions leverage a unique combination of best-in-class, personalized support with powerful predictive data analytics and a proprietary technology platform to address nearly every clinical, administrative, wellness or behavioral health need. Whether facing common issues or an unprecedented challenge like COVID-19, our team of highly trained, compassionate experts work together to go above and beyond expectations, making healthcare easier for our members and ensuring they get the care they need.

raw.title: Sales Group Manager, Inside Sales (Remote - PST, MT, CST ONLY)
raw.excerpt: About The RoleThe Sales Manager, Inside Sales (Group Manager, Inside Sales) is a key inside sales management position at The RealReal.
raw.description:
About The Role

The Sales Manager, Inside Sales (Group Manager, Inside Sales) is a key inside sales management position at The RealReal. As a Group Manager, you will drive an inside sales team focused on acquiring luxury products from our existing consignor base. You're customer-obsessed, adaptable, and passionate about luxury brands, fashion, and sustainability. Above all, you embody the TRR culture through collaboration, driving results, and building for the future.

What You Get To Do Every Day

  • Provide coaching, training and performance management to ensure your team meets or exceeds monthly sales targets

  • Shadow phone interactions, review written correspondence, and examine sales pipeline to monitor and improve team performance

  • Monitor your team’s productivity and motivate individuals to reach daily/weekly/monthly KPIs

  • Interview, hire, train and develop employees

  • Ensure accurate information is captured in Salesforce, providing quality checks as needed

  • Work closely with other sales channels and management teams to drive partnership and alignment

  • Identify opportunities for workflow and reporting improvement and articulate execution plans to management team

  • Coach team in providing world-class consignor experience through phone, email and text interactions

  • Field general Q&A, manage elevated consignor issues directly with consignors and liaise with consignor relations to resolve

What You Bring To The Role

Minimum Requirements:

  • Must live in the Pacific, Mountain, or Central time zone ONLY. No exceptions.

  • Motivated by a desire to win and excel and grow your business in a competitive sales environment

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

  • Thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced work environment

  • Ability to build rapport, establish trust, provide empathy and build credibility quickly

  • Efficiency and strong organizational, time management and communication skills

  • Ability to use technological tools with ease G-Suite, Email, SalesForce, CRM

  • Excitement about growing a team and leading a diverse group of salespeople to success

  • Ability to maintain an upbeat and positive attitude around change

  • Internal: TRR Leadership Development Program (LDP) Graduate

  • Internal: 6 month rolling average 100%+ units

Compensation, Benefits, + Perks

  • Base salary plus uncapped commission

  • Monthly sales competitions (i.e. cash | prizes | site credit)

  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • 401K with Company Match

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance

  • Paid Parental Leave

  • 9 Paid Company Holidays

  • Flexible Time Off (With Manager Approval)

  • Find out more about our Benefits here.

The expected salary range for this role is $85,000-$94,000. To determine starting pay we carefully consider a variety of factors, including primary work location and an evaluation of a candidate’s skills, experience, market demands, and internal parity. Additionally, salary is just one component of TRR’s total rewards package. Depending on role, employees may also be eligible for a bonus program, incentive pay and benefits.The expected On-Target Earnings range for this role is $121,440-$134,285. To determine on-target earnings, the range includes both base salary and target incentive compensation. Target incentive compensation for some roles may include a ramping period. Compensation is higher for those who exceed targets.

The RealReal is the world’s largest online marketplace for authenticated, resale luxury goods, with 40 million members. With a rigorous authentication process overseen by experts, The RealReal provides a safe and reliable platform for consumers to buy and sell their luxury items. We have hundreds of in-house gemologists, horologists, and brand authenticators who inspect thousands of items each day. As a sustainable company, we give new life to pieces by thousands of brands across numerous categories—including women's and men's fashion, fine jewelry and watches, art, and home—in support of the circular economy. We make selling effortless with free virtual appointments, in-home pickup, drop-off, and direct shipping. We handle all of the work for consignors, including authenticating, using AI and machine learning to determine optimal pricing, photographing and listing their items, as well as shipping and customer service.


The RealReal is committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or expression, or Veteran status. We will consider qualified applicants for a position regardless of arrest or conviction records. At TRR, People Come First. That’s why diversity and inclusion are vital to our priorities as an equal opportunity employer. You can read about our Diversity Equity and Inclusion program here.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and taste or smell. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

raw.description:
When applying for roles at Tealium, please use our official careers page or LinkedIn company profile. All other sites where Tealium careers may appear may not be legitimate.

WHO WE ARE

Tealium is the trusted leader in real-time Customer Data Platforms (CDP), helping organizations unify their customer data to deliver more personalized, privacy-conscious experiences. As the demand for connected, intelligent customer engagement grows, Tealium’s leadership in CDP is translating directly into leadership in enabling enterprise AI strategies. By providing clean, consented, and actionable data, Tealium empowers its customers to accelerate the adoption of AI and machine learning, fueling smarter personalization, predictive insights, and business outcomes at scale.

More than 800 leading global brands trust Tealium to power their customer data strategies and deliver real-time, personalized experiences at scale.

Team Tealium has team members present in nearly 20 countries worldwide, serving customers across more than 30 countries. We win together with respect and appreciation for the talents required of all positions and the people who contribute to each of these. We are intentional about our WOWs (Ways of Work) culture, our investment in our team members, and how we care and connect.

With an extraordinary portfolio of investors (including Georgian, Silver Lake Waterman, Battery, and others) and deep industry experience, Tealium has the financial backing, profitability, and expertise to continue to outpace competitors and lead the way in innovation. Today, Tealium holds over 50 patents, and a few of the recent industry recognitions include:

  • A Leader in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms

  • 2025 TrustRadius Award Winner: Buyer’s Choice

  • 2024 Invoca Partner Collaboration Award

  • 2024 G2 Leader in Tag Management & Enterprise Data Governance

  • Tealium Customer Data Hub achieved the Top Rated Award by TrustRadius (2024)

  • Named on Destination CRM’s 2024 Top 100 Technologies List for Sales

  • Named on the 2024 Best and Brightest in the Nation list

  • BuiltIn’s 2024 Best Place to Work

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

Tealium is seeking a Sr. Product Manager to join the Enterprise Product Team. As part of the Tealium Product team, you will build an ecosystem of products that power customer data infrastructure and insights for some of the world’s largest brands. We are looking for an autonomous, strategic thinker who proactively utilizes AI and modern tools to solve complex problems and deliver measurable, high-impact business outcomes. This role is a unique opportunity to independently steer product direction and bring to market features that transform how brands engage with and get closer to their customers.

We are looking for a strategic, highly autonomous product leader who can operate independently, leverage AI and modern tools effectively, and drive measurable business impact. This role requires strong ownership, resourcefulness, data-driven decision-making, adaptability, and cross-functional collaboration to solve complex problems and accelerate product outcomes in a fast-moving environment.

This is a unique opportunity to shape product direction, influence long-term platform strategy, and bring innovative capabilities to market that transform how brands engage with and better understand their customers.

YOUR DAY TO DAY

  • Own the vision, roadmap, prioritization, and end-to-end execution for data collection capabilities across web, server-side, and other digital touchpoints.

  • Define and communicate a clear product direction for helping customers collect data that is accurate, governed, consent-aware, secure, and ready for activation and analysis.

  • Engage with customers and internal stakeholders to understand collection workflows, implementation challenges, regulatory requirements, and unmet needs.

  • Translate changes in privacy regulation, consent expectations, customer needs, technology, and market dynamics into strategic product opportunities.

  • Shape the evolution of event-based data collection, including event schemas, data quality, validation, observability, and interoperability.

  • Break down complex problems and large, cross-functional initiatives into clear, incremental deliverables that teams can plan, build, test, and release.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to establish product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, success measures, and delivery milestones that create shared clarity across teams.

  • Partner closely with engineering and architecture to design scalable solutions that account for upstream and downstream dependencies.

  • Use qualitative and quantitative data to validate opportunities, evaluate tradeoffs, measure outcomes, and continuously refine the product strategy.

  • Provide clear prioritization and decision-making for engineering teams while balancing customer value, technical investment, operational reliability, and business impact.

  • Support go-to-market and adoption efforts through enablement, documentation, product demonstrations, customer conversations, and launch planning.

WHAT YOU BRING TO TEALIUM

  • 7+ years as a Product Manager building SaaS products, with proven success driving customer adoption and retention

  • Deep knowledge of digital data collection, including client-side and server-side tracking, SDKs, APIs, data layers, event pipelines, and collection architectures.

  • Strong understanding of event schemas, tracking plans, and data validation

  • Experience building or managing products that support complex, customized implementations with significant upstream and downstream dependencies.

  • Practical knowledge of consent management, privacy requirements, data governance, data security, and the impact of regulatory obligations on collection design.

  • Experience working with customers in regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, insurance, or the public sector, where privacy, security, auditability, and reliability are critical.

  • Demonstrated ability to understand complex technical systems and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Proven ability to break down ambiguous problems and large initiatives into focused, measurable increments while maintaining a clear connection to the broader strategy.

  • Strong product discovery and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify root causes, test hypotheses, evaluate alternatives, and make informed decisions with incomplete information.

  • Track record of influencing cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders through clear communication, sound judgment, and a strong customer perspective.

  • Experience defining and using success metrics related to data quality, reliability, governance, customer adoption, and business outcomes.

  • High level of ownership, autonomy, and accountability, with the ability to move work forward in a fast-paced, continuously evolving environment.

WAGE TRANSPARENCY

In many U.S. states, employers are required to include a pay range for posted positions. Although this isn't a requirement in every state, communicating transparently is a cornerstone of our operations at Tealium, and we believe in making this information available to all applicants.

The U.S. pay range for this full-time position is listed below, however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to a competitive base salary, this position is eligible for a robust benefits package that includes the following:

  • Employees are eligible to receive an annual bonus and stock options.

  • Employees and their families are eligible for medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance.

  • Employees have the option to enroll in our 401k plan and are eligible to receive contributions for company matching.

  • Employees are eligible for flexible paid time-off and extended paid parental leave.

  • We offer 11 paid holidays annually with an additional Healium Be-Well break for most employees.

  • We offer 15 hours of paid work time for volunteer activities and programs.

  • Our sick leave accrual is the following for our employees:

    • Exempt CA employees (not including San Francisco) including NY : accrue 40 hours each year. Unused sick leave carries over into the next year. Employees cannot exceed 80 hours in a given year.

    • Exempt Non - CA employees (not including NY) including SF: Accrue 1 hour every 30 hours worked. Cannot exceed 180 hours in the calendar year.

    • Non-Exempt: accrue 1 hour every 30 hours worked. Unused carries over to the next year. Not to exceed 108 hours in a calendar year.

An overview of our benefits and perks can be found on our careers page, . Additional details regarding the benefits package will be provided during your interview process.

Compensation Range- $150,000- $175,000 + Variable + Equity Options

WHY YOU WANT TO WORK HERE

At Tealium, we don’t just offer the ordinary, we provide the extraordinary:

  • Tealium WOWs (Ways of Work), our award winning culture is how with think, act and connect together at Tealium
  • Mosaic, our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion is grounded in our mosaic of diverse perspectives and shared belonging as we live in work across the US and in nearly 20 countries
  • Tealium Cares, to promote caring in our communities, 15 hours of paid work time for volunteer activities and programs is offered annually
  • Tealium Connects (remote-first working), enabling many of us to choose where we do our best work and offering new hire stipends to assist with purchasing things we need to support a successful home office environment
  • Tealium Ownership, share in the success of Tealium by becoming an owner of Tealium beginning with new hire equity grants
  • Tealium Time, paid time-off policy to offer flexibility to take time when needed and robust leave programs, including extended paid parental leave and company holidays
  • Healium, health and wellness programs to help us be our best selves in the experiences of health, physical, mental, social, and even financial well-being and wellness
  • Tealium LIFT (Learning is Facilitated at Tealium), offering a myriad of professional development opportunities with over 6,000 courses available on demand to best-in-class manager and leadership development programs
  • Health and Related Benefits Programs, offering market competitive benefits programs
Collectively, we contribute our individual pieces (identity, experiences, heritage, backgrounds, religions, viewpoints, gender and more ) to form the mosaic of Team Tealium. It is our continuing philosophy to recruit and employ the best qualified individuals without regard to race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, and/or any other protected characteristic. Tealium does not tolerate unlawful discrimination of any kind and strives to be an inclusive and respectful workplace.
The highly relevant and differentiated positioning of Tealium’s solutions makes this a unique and rewarding career opportunity.
*Offerings vary by level and location.

raw.title: Senior Product Designer (m/w)
raw.excerpt: Die RIB-Gruppe ist der weltweit führende Anbieter von Softwarelösungen für die Steuerung von Projekt- und Unternehmensprozessen in der Bau- & Immobilienbranche.
raw.description:
Die RIB-Gruppe ist der weltweit führende Anbieter von Softwarelösungen für die Steuerung von Projekt- und Unternehmensprozessen in der Bau- & Immobilienbranche. Mehr als 60 Jahre Branchenerfahrung befähigen uns, unser Ziel, die Bauindustrie zur nachhaltigsten und digitalisiertesten Branche des 21. Jahrhunderts voranzutreiben, mit unseren Kunden erfolgreich zu erreichen: „Building Better Together“.

Die Vision, Bauprojekte durch digitale Arbeitsmethoden effizienter und transparenter zu machen, haben wir in den letzten Jahren bei unseren Kunden Realität werden lassen - doch damit geben wir uns noch nicht zufrieden: wir wollen der Bauindustrie die Spitzenposition der Zukunft sichern!

Dies ermöglichen unsere 2.500 Mitarbeiter*innen weltweit; davon > 500 Mitarbeiter*innen in DACH. Als eigenständiges Unternehmen der Schneider Electric eröffnen wir dir dabei nationale und internationale Karrierechancen und sinnstiftende Aufgaben in kaufmännischen und technischen Bereichen. Sei ein Teil davon #ONERIB

Als Produktdesigner (m/w) in unserem internationalen Team, bringst du unsere Bausoftwarelösungen mit deinen Designs auf das next Level. Dabei agierst du eng mit Senior Designern, Produktmanagern und Entwicklern (alle m/w) auf nationaler und internationaler Ebene. Du bist der kreative Kopf, der Nutzerbedürfnisse in intuitive Benutzeroberflächen verwandelst: von der Analyse über die Nutzerforschung bis zum finalen Design – hier prägst du die User Experience und machst komplexe Prozesse einfach verständlich. Bist Du bereit, echte Mehrwerte zu schaffen?

Dein neuer Verantwortungsbereich:

  • Übernimm Designaufgaben von Wireframes bis zur Implementierung und arbeite eng mit dem Designsystem-Team zusammen, um Designs konsistent und skalierbar zu gestalten.

  • Setze Lean UX-Prinzipien ein, um dein Design iterativ durch Feedback und Daten zu verbessern. Nimm aktiv an Workshops teil und stelle sicher, dass deine Lösungen sowohl den geschäftlichen Anforderungen als auch den Bedürfnissen der Nutzer gerecht werden

  • Führe Nutzerforschung durch und profitiere vom Wissenstransfer erfahrener Teammitglieder, um wertvolle Erkenntnisse direkt in deine Designentscheidungen einzubringen. Dein Verständnis für Nutzerverhalten unterstützt den gesamten Designprozess.

  • Plane und führe Usability-Tests durch, nutze Prototypen für Feedback und optimiere Benutzerflüsse zur Verbesserung der Benutzererfahrung.

  • Analysiere gemeinsam mit dem Produktteam Event-Tracking-Daten, erkenne relevante Verhaltensmuster und nutze diese Insights, um Benutzerflüsse und Designelemente zu optimieren.

The Manager maintains and drives the adoption of methodology for the corporate platforms and provides tools, training and support, aligned to the corporate strategy.

  • 5 years experience in the financial services industry

  • Experience in projects and change initiates in relation to enhancing of processes and procedures

  • High level understand of how various products within the Salesforce ecosystem should be utilized

  • At least 3 years proven experience solving problems using quantitative approaches.

  • At least 3 years experience with large datasets

  • Experience with advanced data visualization best practice and techniques

  • Understanding of business requirements and transforming them into actionable solutions.

  • Working knowledge of sales engagement platforms and document management platforms

  • Proven experience with preparing presentations for consumption by senior leadership audiences, resulting in understanding and buy-in for recommendations made based on data

  • BSc. / MSc / MBA in finance, economics, accounting, mathematics, data science or computer science

  • Familiarity with Tableau, Alteryx and other tools used for analytics

  • Salesforce certification would be an asset.

Main Accountabilities:

  • Manages & maintains design, and implementation of assigned new initiatives to ensure that the projects are implemented within timeframes and budget and realization of business benefits, providing seamless delivery of change initiatives.

  • Manages & maintains Salesforce and applications by troubleshooting inquiries and conducting root cause analysis, logging & tracking issues and assisting in triaging solutions to improve internal user experience and external client experience, driving market penetration in line with strategy and product development within the main Salesforce platform and bespoke applications to optimize license allocation and facilitate cost efficiencies.

raw.excerpt: About FullscriptWe’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better.
raw.description:
About Fullscript

We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.

That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.

We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.

This is your invitation.

Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.

The Opportunity

Fullscript is looking for an AI Enablement Specialist to help Fullscripters use AI confidently, responsibly, and effectively in their day-to-day work.

You will join Team GSD, Fullscript's AI and automation enablement team. GSD helps departments improve how work gets done by combining practical AI education, workflow discovery, and scalable automation. This role will own the human side of that work: turning fast-moving AI capabilities and internal tools into clear, useful learning experiences that meet people where they are.
This is primarily a content, enablement, and adoption role. You will build the self-serve resources, interactive learning experiences, communications, and support models that help teams learn independently. You will also work with stakeholders to uncover workflow pain points, assess AI and automation opportunities, and translate what you learn into clear inputs for the GSD roadmap.
You will not be expected to build machine learning models or act as a full-time trainer. You should, however, be hands-on and credible with modern AI tools, curious about how people learn, and comfortable facilitating a live session or webinar when it is the best way to help a group move forward.

What you'll do

  • Own the creation of Fullscript’s AI training and development content, including practical guides, slide decks, blogs, videos, playbooks, templates, and role-based learning paths.

  • Build and continuously improve interactive, self-serve learning experiences that make Fullscript’s AI knowledge easy to find, understand, and apply independently.

  • Identify user groups, learning needs, and skill gaps across Fullscript, then tailor content to their workflows, business context, and level of AI fluency.

  • Stay current on AI tools, capabilities, use cases, and emerging trends, using that knowledge to keep Fullscript’s learning materials accurate, relevant, and practical.

  • Partner with AI Champions to shape departmental adoption roadmaps, equip them with reusable resources, and support the rollout and internal go-to-market of new AI tools.

  • Build strong relationships across the business, observe how teams work, and uncover operational pain points, knowledge gaps, and opportunities for AI or automation.

  • Gather requirements and frame opportunities by documenting the problem, users, current workflow, expected impact, data needs, feasibility, and risk, then translate those insights into clear recommendations for GSD roadmap planning.

  • Serve as a frontline enablement partner for GSD applications, turning recurring questions, adoption barriers, and user feedback into better content, product guidance, and roadmap inputs.

  • Measure and improve enablement through signals such as content engagement, tool usage, proficiency, support trends, time saved, and business impact.

  • Facilitate select workshops, webinars, office hours, or onboarding sessions, share useful practices across teams, and occasionally represent Fullscript at relevant industry events.

What you bring to the table

  • Experience in learning and development, technical enablement, digital learning, knowledge management, change enablement, developer education, or a related field.

  • Hands-on fluency with modern AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or similar platforms, along with a practical understanding of what large language models can and cannot do.

  • Experience designing clear, engaging learning content for people with different roles, levels of technical knowledge, and ways of learning.

  • A track record of building self-serve resources or digital learning experiences that improved adoption, confidence, or performance.

  • Strong business analysis skills. You can uncover the real problem behind a request, map a workflow, gather requirements, and translate business needs into clear next steps for a technical team.

  • Excellent written communication and information design skills, with the judgment to make complex ideas simple without making them inaccurate.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to earn trust with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong project management and prioritization skills, with the ability to move several enablement initiatives forward without losing sight of quality or outcomes.

  • A practical, people-first approach to change. You understand that adoption depends on relevance, trust, clarity, and support, not simply access to a new tool.

  • Comfort facilitating a live learning session, webinar, or group discussion when needed.

Bonus if you have

  • Experience with low-code or no-code automation tools such as n8n, Zapier, or Make.

  • Experience creating interactive learning experiences or lightweight web applications using low-code, no-code, or AI-assisted development tools.

  • Familiarity with AI workflow concepts such as agents, connectors, model selection, evaluation, and human-in-the-loop review.

  • Experience launching internal tools or leading adoption and communication programs in a technology-driven organization.

  • Experience building or supporting a champions network, guild, cohort, or internal community of practice.

  • Familiarity with AI governance, data privacy, or enablement in healthcare or another regulated environment.

  • Experience speaking at industry events, facilitating communities, or creating external thought-leadership content.

What we can offer you

  • Remote-first flexibility to work where you work best, with Ottawa, Toronto, or Calgary preferred for this role.

  • Flexible PTO and competitive pay, because work-life balance matters

  • RRSP/401k match and competitive compensation packages to invest in your future

  • Premium benefits package with customizable coverage, paramedical services, and an HSA.

  • Fullscript discounts to save on high-quality wellness products

  • Continuous learning opportunities to grow your skills and career

Compensation range

The salary range for this role is between $80,000 and $90,000 (CAD). Fullscript shares salary ranges to support transparency and help candidates make informed decisions. The range shown reflects base salary only. The range shown reflects base salary only. Additional incentives, perks, and benefits may be available as part of Fullscript’s total rewards package.

Final compensation depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region.

Why Fullscript

Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door.

What to Know Before You Apply

We’re grateful for the interest in joining Fullscript. To make sure your application reaches our hiring team, please apply directly through our careers page.

A quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, we’re not able to respond to phone or email inquiries about application status. If there’s a match, our team will reach out directly.

All offers are contingent on successful background checks conducted in compliance with federal, state, and provincial laws.

We use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, including screening and reviewing responses. Final hiring decisions are always made by people and follow all applicable privacy and employment laws in Canada and the U.S.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Workday Integration Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$180,000 Annually
Experience Required: 12+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are looking for a Workday Integration Developer to design, develop, and maintain integrations between Workday and the broader enterprise application landscape. The role focuses on hands-on integration delivery using EIB, Studio, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, and Workday APIs, with strong attention to reliability, security, and data quality. The ideal candidate has shipped meaningful Workday integrations in production, navigates Workday’s tenant model and security framework with confidence, and writes well-structured Studio integrations that are easy to maintain. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop Workday integrations using EIB, Workday Studio, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, and PECI.
  • Build inbound and outbound integrations connecting Workday with payroll, benefits, IT provisioning, finance, and analytics systems.
  • Develop XSLT transformations within Workday Studio integrations, applying disciplined templating practices, reusable helper libraries, and careful test coverage to keep complex mappings maintainable.
  • Implement integrations using Workday REST and SOAP web services where appropriate.
  • Design error handling, retry, and notification strategies that ensure reliable integration operations.
  • Develop and maintain integration system users, ISSGs, security configurations, and tenant-level setup for integrations.
  • Build and maintain calculated fields, custom reports, and report-as-a-service integrations.
  • Implement Workday business processes and condition rules that support integration logic, ensuring the upstream and downstream sides of each integration agree on routing, approvals, and state transitions.
  • Participate actively in Workday tenant refresh planning and integration regression testing, ensuring critical integration paths are exercised in lower environments before each tenant move and any drift is caught early.
  • Collaborate with HR, payroll, IT, and finance stakeholders to translate business needs into integration designs.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Support production incidents related to integrations and drive durable fixes.
  • Participate in Workday release planning and regression testing, reviewing upcoming feature changes for impact, scheduling validation cycles, and coordinating with stakeholders so adoption proceeds smoothly.
  • Stay current with Workday product releases and integration platform evolution.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 12 or more years of Workday integration development experience.
  • Deep expertise in EIB, Workday Studio, and Core Connectors.
  • Strong XSLT skills and experience with Workday Studio orchestrations.
  • Hands-on experience with Workday REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Strong understanding of the Workday data model and tenant configuration.
  • Experience with Workday security model including ISU/ISSG patterns.
  • Familiarity with calculated fields and custom report design.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Workday Pro Integrations certification.
  • Experience with PICOF, PECI, or Cloud Connect for Payroll.
  • Familiarity with Workday Extend.
  • Exposure to multi-tenant or multi-region Workday deployments.
  • Experience integrating Workday with major SaaS platforms (ServiceNow, Salesforce).

How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 505-3899. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at .
Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

raw.description:
About us

Pet Media Group (PMG) is a scale-up that acquires, launches, and develops market-leading pet marketplaces globally, with over 1.5 million animals finding new homes through our platforms every year. We currently operate in 6 countries (UK, Sweden, Netherlands, Italy, Spain, and the US), all within just 5 years of launching. Here's one of our apps:

The way pets find new loving homes has remained largely unchanged for centuries. We're on a mission to change that through innovative technology, and increasingly through the intelligent use of AI. We're a young and ambitious team who have built unicorns before (e.g. Avito), backed by some of Europe's leading investors (e.g. Verdane and Otiva, early backers of Klarna, CAIA, Apotea, and Easypark).

Who are we looking for?

We're growing our Monetisation team and looking for an Engineering Manager to lead it. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll grow and support a team of engineers, own delivery and technical direction for the Monetisation domain, and stay close enough to the code to make sound calls alongside your team.

The Monetisation team works on several key parts of the business. In the VAS (value-added services) domain they build and maintain everything from pricing, checkouts and payment processing, recurring subscriptions, product activations, and experimentation/CRO. They also build and maintain an escrow system that lets users safely run the entire transaction through the platform, touching topics like KYC/KYB/identity verification, payment processing and payouts.

You'll be accountable for how this team performs: the quality of what it ships, the growth of the people on it, and how the roadmap connects daily engineering work to revenue outcomes. You'll partner closely with product and the wider engineering leadership to set priorities and clear blockers.

We also want someone who treats AI as a core part of how a modern team works. You encourage your engineers to use LLMs and AI tooling in their daily workflow, and you have a view on where the technology takes our ways of working.

What you'll do

  • Lead, grow and support a team of full-stack engineers (1:1s, career development, hiring, feedback)

  • Own delivery for the Monetisation domain: predictable, high-quality shipping against a clear roadmap

  • Set technical direction with your team and stay hands-on enough to guide architecture and unblock hard problems

  • Partner with product to shape priorities across VAS, payments and escrow

  • Champion AI-assisted engineering as a standard part of how the team builds

Requirements

We're a fast-growing scale-up. We want teams that build fast, fail fast, and learn fast. You don't need to be a world-class expert in every tool we use, but you do need a critical, open mindset, a strong engineering background, and a genuine enthusiasm for AI-assisted development.

Core (required):

  • Experience managing and growing a team of software engineers, including people development and hiring

  • Experience in the payments or fintech space (Stripe, Adyen, Braintree), or with escrow / KYC / identity verification

  • A strong engineering background yourself, ideally full-stack with TypeScript, Next.js, Node.js and React

  • A track record of owning delivery for a team or domain: turning strategy into a roadmap and shipping it

  • Comfortable staying technical: reviewing designs, guiding architecture, and making trade-offs with your team

  • Understanding of GraphQL and its usage in large systems with multiple consumers

  • Experience with relational databases like PostgreSQL

  • Active use of AI tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor, Codex) in engineering work, and a point of view on how teams should adopt them

  • Working proficiency in English is required

Bonus (helpful & appreciated):

  • Experience with monitoring & observability tools like Grafana

  • Experience with experimentation / CRO

  • Experience introducing or scaling AI coding workflows at team or company level

Our tech stack

Next.js, React, Node.js & React Native (TypeScript throughout) · GitLab CI/CD · Elasticsearch · Redis · GraphQL & PostgreSQL · Knex · Docker · Serverless with AWS Lambda · AWS · Grafana · Bitrise

What we offer

  • Join a rapidly growing, already-profitable business with a clear vision and genuine energy

  • Full ownership of a mission-critical domain and the team behind it

  • A diverse team across Sweden, Germany, Austria, UK, Poland, Portugal, Bosnia, Croatia, Ukraine and Egypt

  • A real opportunity to shape our tech department and help define how AI becomes part of how we build

  • Competitive compensation and great benefits (remote or in-person)

We very much look forward to your application, contact us if you have any questions!
