Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You Will Love This Role

The Cribl Product Management team sits at the center of the entire company, responsible for ensuring that the product strategy and execution aligns closely with our customers’ needs and company values. Product Managers at Cribl are more than just backlog babysitters, we go beyond delivery of features and ensure that we are creating value, lowering barriers of entry and accelerating adoption through the entire customer journey.

We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to be a part of the Core Search foundation team. You will play a key part in driving the vision and effective delivery of development and sales. Your focus will be on collecting customer and partner feedback, prioritizing feature asks and bugs, and enabling successful delivery of customer use cases for the primary Search platform, including Federated, Metric, and Lakehouse search. You will also work with marketing and the field to enable technical training, new product features and launches, and new customer value messaging.


As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will...

  • Iterate with PM leads as well as peer PMs to prioritize features and present a coordinated roadmap across multiple dimensions of product and functionality
  • Negotiate with Engineering Management for feature prioritization in the context of available of resources and competing requests
  • Present roadmaps and investigate use cases with customers and partners
  • Triage and prioritize incoming feature requests, bug reports, and project ideas
  • Maintain development team backlog in light of company strategy and team goals
  • Maintain status visibility with leadership and stakeholders across the company
  • Understand and communicate the fiscal cost-benefit and license impact of specific integrations
  • Work with marketing and customer success to establish clear "golden path" use cases and enable the field with these materials
  • Develop and deliver public resources (videos, blogs, talks) supporting the product
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and fill gaps in product offering or product enablement.
  • Monitor and analyze the effectiveness of integrations through product metrics and stakeholder feedback to drive continuous improvement.
  • Serve as the central point of contact for Search integrations, providing proactive assistance and expertise to elevate team performance.
  • We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours.


If You’ve Got It - We Want It:

  • 5+ years of experience in a customer facing Product Management role with experience in one or more of the following areas: observability, metrics, analytics, cyber security, big data system integrations or SaaS.
  • Strong experience working with big data / analytics products with query languages such as SQL, KQL, SPL, or other analytics languages and platforms
  • Experience with and understanding of challenges of working with data at the Terabyte and Petabyte scale
  • Understanding of network protocols used for data transport, and data structures used for data processing and storage
  • Experience with the Agile development methodology and proven ability to work within the Atlassian suite of products, especially Jira and Confluence.
  • Proven ability to manage delivery and maintenance of complex data integration systems that drive measurable outcomes.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple programs and priorities simultaneously.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate business requirements and technical concepts into actionable requirements.
  • Experience collaborating across departments, including Sales, Product, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success teams.
  • Experience with a free Cribl sandbox.
  • Self-starter with a strategic mindset, attention to detail, and a drive for continuous improvement.

The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

Base Salary Range
$190,000—$230,000 USD

Bring Your Whole Self
Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

The role involves preparing and drafting estate planning documents such as wills, trusts, powers of attorney, healthcare directives, and deeds, as well as communicating with clients, scheduling appointments, providing case updates, and coordinating signing meetings.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, responsive, and detail-oriented, with strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Communicate with clients regarding case status, document drafts, next steps, and appointments.

  • Prepare and organize estate planning binders and signing documents, ensuring accuracy and proper execution.

  • Conduct limited legal research and assist with assembling complex trust packages under attorney guidance.

  • Coordinate with attorneys, intake specialists, administrative staff, and other legal assistants to ensure smooth case progression.

  • Finalize and organize executed documents, assemble post-signing binders, and assist with deed recording and follow-up.

Qualifications

  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong ability to follow established processes, maintain accurate records, and meet deadlines.

  • Ability to work effectively independently and as part of a legal team.

  • Previous experience in estate planning, legal support, or a similar role is preferred.

Why RecruitGo?

RecruitGo seamlessly links world-class business partners with top-tier global talent in emerging markets. Secure legal employment through our Employer of Record services and embark on a journey to unparalleled professional opportunities.

raw.description:
Do you crave a career that truly makes an impact in people’s lives? Do you thrive on problem-solving and finding solutions? Join a dedicated, tight-knit team that creates an immediate and meaningful impact every day

Leidos QTC Health Services is seeking a Fleet Supervisor on our Mobile Clinic Operations Team. As the Fleet Supervisor you will plan, organize, and direct fleet functions, services, and activities to ensure safe, compliant, reliable, and cost-efficient transportation services in support of mobile clinical operations. This role supervises Class A and clinical drivers and fleet administration staff and oversees the proper maintenance and modification of mobile medical clinics and support vehicles to ensure DOT/FMCSA compliance and employee safety during travel and clinic operations. The Fleet Supervisor drives continuous improvement in fleet uptime, operating cost per mile, driver safety, and regulatory audit readiness.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Supervise a team of Class A and clinical drivers and/or fleet administration staff to effectively deliver fleet functions, services, and activities; recommend improvements to fleet operations to meet current and future business needs; responsible for hiring, onboarding, performance appraisals, and recognition/disciplinary actions.
  • Ensure FMCSA/DOT compliance across fleet activities — Driver Qualification Files (DQF), hours-of-service (HOS), drug & alcohol testing, vehicle inspection and maintenance records, DVIRs, registration, IFTA, and permits — in collaboration with the Logistics Manager and Fleet Coordinators.
  • Maintain and periodically audit Driver Qualification Files per 49 CFR Part 391, including MVRs, medical certificates, applications, road tests, and pre-employment screenings.
  • Oversee HOS compliance and the ELD program per 49 CFR Part 395: monitor logs, address violations, run exception reports, and enforce corrective actions, partnering with Fleet Coordinators on day-to-day execution.
  • Review all vehicle maintenance and inspection records per 49 CFR Part 396; assist with vehicle inspections, preventive maintenance scheduling, repairs, and parts inventory to minimize downtime and extend asset life, in coordination with the Logistics Manager.
  • Oversee and maintain the electronic, cloud-based vehicle and staff reporting system, ensuring fleet availability for operational requests at all times and accurate recordkeeping for all vehicle-related services.
  • Oversee pre- and post-trip inspections; ensure DVIR corrective actions and timely closure of work orders in the maintenance system; support roadside inspection readiness and promptly correct out-of-service (OOS) conditions.
  • Monitor weather and other conditions that may impact routes and locations and advise on alternative routes for the safety of staff and vehicles; review routes and travel plans with Fleet Coordinators to optimize safety and efficiency.
  • Communicate with drivers, verbally and in writing, to understand needs and implement solutions; may authorize emergency repairs, vehicle replacement, and other associated costs.
  • Monitor and analyze fleet KPIs — uptime, MTTR, cost per mile, fuel economy, idle time, and accident rate — and collaborate with the Logistics Manager and Fleet Coordinators to develop and implement improvement plans.
  • Ensure driver medical certification and Drug & Alcohol Clearinghouse compliance; assist with coordination of DOT-mandated drug & alcohol testing (pre-employment, random, post-accident, and reasonable suspicion) in collaboration with Human Resources.
  • Assist with incidents and accidents; coordinate with Claims, Legal, and Safety teams; collect evidence and prepare incident reports with corrective actions in accordance with company policy and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Assist with and coordinate driver recruiting, onboarding, training, and retention in partnership with Human Resources; ensure licensing and training renewals, and coordinate re-certification as regulations change.
  • Provide oversight of driver travel cards, MHC payment cards, and fuel card usage and charges.
  • Ensure compliance with multi-state Highway Use Tax (HUT) and Weight-Mile Tax requirements (e.g., New York HUT, Oregon Weight-Mile Tax, and comparable Kentucky, New Mexico, and Connecticut programs) across applicable operating states.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college in a related discipline (Logistics or Business Operations preferred), or equivalent combined education and experience.
  • Valid Class A Commercial Driver's License (CDL) required, with 5+ years of CDL driving experience.
  • Minimum 4 years of experience in transportation, supervising drivers and coordinating activities for 5 or more vehicles, preferably in a healthcare environment.
  • 5+ years of experience with cloud-based fleet/personnel management systems highly desirable.
  • Valid U.S. driver's license and ability/willingness to drive between work locations.
  • Must be able to successfully pass National Agency Check with Inquiries (NACI) background investigation

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Regulatory compliance and DOT/FMCSA audit readiness.
  • Safety-first mindset and incident response.
  • Strong leadership skills, with the ability to prioritize and delegate effectively; coaching, staffing, and performance management.
  • Experience with electronic logging devices (ELD) and cloud-based fleet/personnel management systems.
  • Ability to effectively manage competing priorities with a sense of urgency.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and cross-functional collaboration under pressure.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to effectively prioritize work.
  • Proficiency with MS Office Suite.
  • Strong sense of responsibility, creativity, self-motivation, and ability to work in a team environment.
  • Ability to provide excellent customer service.
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule (e.g., weekends, after-hours availability) and travel up to 40% of the time.

Additional Information: (only add applicable items)

  • Job Location: Remote
  • Travel requirements: up to 40% of the time or per business needs

About Leidos QTC Health Services

Leidos QTC Health Services collaborates closely with government and non-government customers to address current and future program needs within the health services domain. We specialize in disability-focused medical examinations, independent medical exams and review services, occupational health services, diagnostic testing, and case management solutions. As innovators, we focus on advancing technologies that improve service delivery, with a particular emphasis on enhancing accessibility for examinees in rural communities. With a proven track record of continuous improvement and steady growth, we now handle over 2 million appointments annually. Visit for more information.

Compensation and Benefits

Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers.
